Ngakho inhliziyo yami iyathokoza, lodumo lwami luyajabula, lenyama yami izahlala ivikelekile.
Ngoba kawutshiyanga umphefumulo wami esihogweni, njalo kawuyikunikela ongcwele wakho ukuthi abone ukubola.
Uzangazisa indlela yempilo; ukugcwala kwentokozo kusebukhoneni bakho, ngakwesokunene sakho kukhona izinjabulo phakade.
Zwana ukulunga, Nkosi, ulalele ukukhala kwami; ubeke indlebe emkhulekweni wami ongaphumi ezindebeni ezilenkohliso.
Ukwahlulelwa kwami kakuphume ebukhoneni bakho, amehlo akho kawabone izinto eziqondileyo.
Uyilingile inhliziyo yami, wangihambela ebusuku; ungihlolile, kawuficanga lutho; ngihlosile, umlomo wami kawuyikuphambuka.
Mayelana lezenzo zabantu, ngelizwi lendebe zakho, mina ngizinqandile ezindleleni zomchithi,
ukusekela izinyathelo zami emikhondweni yakho, ukuze inyawo zami zingatsheleli.
Mina ngikubizile, ngoba uzangiphendula, Nkulunkulu; beka indlebe yakho kimi, uzwe inkulumo yami.
Tshengisa ngokumangalisayo uthandolomusa wakho, wena osindisa ngesandla sakho sokunene labo abathembela kuwe kwabavukelayo.
Ngigcine njengenhlamvu yelihlo; ungifihle emthunzini wempiko zakho,
kubo ubuso bababi abangicindezelayo, izitha zempilo yami ezingihanqileyo.
Bayazivalela ngamahwahwa abo; ngomlomo wabo bakhuluma ngokuzigqaja.
Sebesihanqile emanyathelweni ethu; amehlo abo bawamise besithobele emhlabathini.
Unjengesilwane esikhuthalele ukudabula, lanjengesilwane esitsha esiquthileyo endaweni ezisithekileyo.
Vuka, Nkosi! Uhlangabeze ubuso bakhe, umphosele phansi. Khulula umphefumulo wami komubi, oyinkemba yakho,

kubo abantu, abayisandla sakho, Nkosi, ebantwini bomhlaba, osabelo sabo sikulokhukuphila, osisu sabo usigcwalisa ngokuligugu kwakho; bagcwele abantwana, njalo batshiyele izingane zabo okuseleyo kwabo.
Mina, ngizakhangela ubuso bakho ekulungeni, ngeneliswe yisimo sakho ekuphaphameni kwami.
Ngizakuthanda, Nkosi, mandla ami.
INkosi ilidwala lami, lenqaba yami, lomkhululi wami; uNkulunkulu wami, idwala lami, engizaphephela kulo, isihlangu sami, lophondo losindiso lwami, inqaba yami ephakemeyo.
Ngizabiza iNkosi edumisekayo, ngakho ngizasindiswa ezitheni zami.
Izibopho zokufa zangizingelezela, lezikhukhula zobubi zangethusa.
Izibopho zesihogo zangigombolozela, imijibila yokufa yayiphambi kwami.
Ekuhluphekeni kwami ngayibiza iNkosi, ngakhala kuNkulunkulu wami; walizwa ilizwi lami esethempelini lakhe, lokukhala kwami kweza phambi kwakhe, endlebeni zakhe.
Khona umhlaba wazamazama, wanyikinyeka, lezisekelo zezintaba zaqhaqhazela, zazamazama, ngoba wayethukuthele.
Kwenyuka intuthu emakhaleni akhe, lomlilo ophuma emlonyeni wakhe waqothula; amalahle avuthiswa yiwo.
Wasekhothamisa amazulu, wehlela phansi, lomnyama onzima wawungaphansi kwenyawo zakhe.
Wasegada ikherubhi*, waphapha, wandiza phezu kwempiko zomoya.
Wamisa umnyama waba yindawo yakhe yensitha, idumba lakhe inhlangothi zonke zakhe, amanzi amnyama, amayezi amnyama omkhathi.
Ekukhazimuleni okuphambi kwakhe amayezi akhe amnyama edlula, isiqhotho lamalahle omlilo.
INkosi yasiduma emazulwini, oPhezukonke wazwakalisa ilizwi lakhe, isiqhotho lamalahle omlilo.
Yasithuma imitshoko yayo, yabachitha; lemibane eminengi, yabaphaphathekisa.
Khona kwabonakala imisele yamanzi, kwembulwa izisekelo zomhlaba ekusoleni kwakho, Nkosi, ekuvutheleni komoya wamakhala akho.
Yathuma iphezulu, yangibamba, yangenyula emanzini amanengi.
Yangophula esitheni sami esilamandla, lakibo abangizondayo, ngoba babelamandla kulami.
Babephambi kwami osukwini lwenhlupheko yami, kodwa iNkosi yaba yisisekelo sami.
Yangikhuphela endaweni ebanzi, yangikhulula ngoba yayithokoza ngami.
INkosi yangivuza njengokulunga kwami; yangibuyisela njengokuhlanzeka kwezandla zami.
Ngoba ngizilondolozile indlela zeNkosi, kangisukanga kuNkulunkulu wami ngenkohlakalo.
Ngoba zonke izahlulelo zayo zaziphambi kwami, lezimiso zayo kangiziphambulanga kimi.
Njalo ngangiqondile kuyo, ngizinqandile ebubini bami.
Ngakho iNkosi ingibuyisele njengokulunga kwami, njengokuhlanzeka kwezandla zami phambi kwamehlo ayo.
Kolesihawu uzaziveza ulesihawu; koqotho uzaziveza uqotho;
kohlanzekileyo uzaziveza uhlanzekile; lakophambukileyo uzaziveza uphambukile.
Ngoba wena uzabasindisa abantu abahlutshwayo; kodwa amehlo aphakemeyo uzawehlisela phansi.
Ngoba wena uzalumathisa isibane sami; iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wami, izakhanyisa ubumnyama bami.
Ngoba ngawe ngigijimile ngadabula phakathi kwebutho, langoNkulunkulu wami ngeqe umthangala.
UNkulunkulu, indlela yakhe iphelele; ilizwi leNkosi lihloliwe; uyisihlangu kubo bonke abaphephela kuye.
Ngoba ngubani onguNkulunkulu ngaphandle kweNkosi? Njalo ngubani olidwala ngaphandle kukaNkulunkulu wethu?
NguNkulunkulu ongibhincisa amandla, owenza indlela yami iphelele.
Owenza inyawo zami zibe njengezezimpala, wangimisa ezingqongeni zami.

Ngiyatshona odakeni olujulileyo, lapho okungelakuma khona; ngingene emanzini atshonayo, lapho impophoma iyangicwilisa.
Ngidiniwe yikukhala kwami, umphimbo wami womile qha; amehlo ami ayafiphala ekulindeleni uNkulunkulu wami.
Abangizondayo ngeze banengi okwedlula inwele zekhanda lami; abangangibhubhisa, izitha zami ngaphandle kwecala, balamandla. Lokho engingakwebanga ngasengikubuyisela.
Nkulunkulu, wena uyabazi ubuthutha bami, lezono zami kazifihlakalanga kuwe.
Kabangayangeki ngenxa yami labo abakulindeleyo, Nkosi Jehova wamabandla; bangadunyazwa ngenxa yami labo abakudingayo, Nkulunkulu kaIsrayeli.
Ngoba ngenxa yakho ngithwele ihlazo; inhloni zisibekele ubuso bami.
Sengaba ngowemzini kubafowethu, lowezizweni kubantwana bakamama.
Ngoba ukutshisekela indlu yakho kungidlile, lenhlamba yabakuhlambazayo iwele phezu kwami.
Ngasengilila ekuzileni ukudla komphefumulo wami, njalo kwaba yikudunyazwa kimi.
Ngasengisenza isaka isembatho sami, ngaba yisiga kibo.
Abahlezi esangweni bakhuluma ngami, njalo ngaba yingoma yabanatha okunathwayo okulamandla.
Kodwa mina umkhuleko wami ukuwe, Nkosi, ngesikhathi somusa, Nkulunkulu, ngobunengi besihawu sakho, ngiphendule, ngeqiniso losindiso lwakho.
Ungophule odakeni, ngingatshoni; ngikhululwe kwabangizondayo lenzikini yamanzi.
Impophoma yamanzi kayingangicwilisi, lenziki ingangiginyi, lomgodi ungavali umlomo wawo phezu kwami.
Ngiphendula, Nkosi, ngoba uthandolomusa wakho lulungile; ngobunengi besihawu sakho uphendukele kimi.
Njalo ungayifihleli ubuso bakho inceku yakho; ngoba ngiyahlupheka, phangisa ungiphendule.
Sondela emphefumulweni wami, uwuhlenge, ungikhulule ngenxa yezitha zami.
Wena uyakwazi ukuthukwa kwami lehlazo lami lokudunyazwa kwami; izitha zami zonke ziphambi kwakho.
Ukuthukwa kuyidabule inhliziyo yami, njalo ngibuthakathaka. Bengilindele ongangihawukela, kodwa wayengekho, labaduduzayo, kodwa kangibatholanga.
Basebengipha inyongo ibe yikudla kwami, lekomeni kwami banginathisa iviniga.
Itafula labo eliphambi kwabo kalibe ngumjibila, ibe yisifu sabonwabileyo.
Amehlo abo kawafiphale ukuze bangaboni, njalo wenze inkalo zabo zihlale zithuthumele.
Thela intukuthelo yakho phezu kwabo, lolaka lwakho oluvuthayo lubafice.
Indawo yabo yokuhlala kayibe lunxiwa, kungabi khona ohlala emathenteni abo.
Ngoba omtshayileyo wena bayamzingela, njalo baxoxa kube buhlungu kwabalinyazwe nguwe.
Yengezelela ukona ekoneni kwabo, ukuze bangangeni ekulungeni kwakho.
Kabesulwe ogwalweni lwabaphilayo, bangabalwa kanye labalungileyo.
Kodwa mina ngilusizi, ngiyafuthelwa; usindiso lwakho, Nkulunkulu, kalungimise phezulu ngivikelekile.
Ngizadumisa ibizo likaNkulunkulu ngehubo, ngimkhulise ngokubonga.
Kuzakuba kuhle-ke eNkosini okwedlula inkabi kumbe ijongosi elilempondo lenklagu.
Abathobekileyo bazabona, bathokoze; lina elidinga uNkulunkulu inhliziyo yenu izaphila.
Ngoba iNkosi iyabezwa abaswelayo, njalo kayideleli izibotshwa zayo.
Kakuthi amazulu lomhlaba kuyidumise, izinlwandle lakho konke okunyakaza phakathi kwazo.
Ngoba uNkulunkulu uzasindisa iZiyoni, ayakhe imizi yakoJuda; njalo bahlale khona badle ilifa layo.

Nkulunkulu, ngophula, Nkosi, phangisa ungisize.

Kuwe, Nkosi, ngiyaphephela; kangingayangeki lanininini.
Ngikhulula ngokulunga kwakho, ungophule; beka indlebe yakho kimi, ungisindise.
Woba lidwala lokuhlala kimi, ngiye kulo njalonjalo; ulayile ukungisindisa, ngoba ulidwala lami lenqaba yami.
Nkulunkulu wami, ngophula esandleni somubi lesandleni songalunganga lolesihluku.
Ngoba wena, ulithemba lami Nkosi, Jehova, ithemba lami kwasebutsheni bami.
Ngeyame kuwe kwasesizalweni; nguwe owangikhupha esiswini sikamama; indumiso yami ingawe njalonjalo.
Benginjengesimangaliso kwabanengi; kodwa wena uyisiphephelo sami esiqinileyo.
Umlomo wami kawugcwaliswe ngendumiso yakho, usuku lonke ngodumo lwakho.
Ungangilahli esikhathini sokuluphala, ungangitshiyi ekupheleni kwamandla ami.

besithi: UNkulunkulu umtshiyile; zingelani, limbambe, ngoba kakho okhululayo.
Nkulunkulu, ungabi khatshana lami; Nkulunkulu wami, phangisela usizo lwami.
Kabayangeke baphele abayizitha zomphefumulo wami, kabasitshekelwe yikuyangeka lehlazo labo abadinga ukoniwa kwami.
Kodwa mina ngizathemba njalonjalo, ngengeze ekudunyisweni kwakho konke.
Umlomo wami uzalandisa ukulunga kwakho, usuku lonke usindiso lwakho, ngoba kangiwazi amanani akho.

Nkulunkulu, ungifundisile kusukela ebutsheni bami, njalo kuze kube khathesi ngitshumayele izimangaliso zakho.
Lalapho sengiluphele sengiyimpunga, Nkulunkulu, ungangitshiyi, ngize ngitshumayele ingalo yakho kuso isizukulwana, amandla akho kuye wonke ozakuza.
Lokulunga kwakho, Nkulunkulu, kufika ezingqongeni, owenze izinto ezinkulu; Nkulunkulu, ngubani onjengawe?
Ongenze ngabona inhlupheko ezinengi lezibuhlungu, uzangivuselela futhi, ungikhuphule futhi ezinzikini zomhlaba.
Uzakwandisa ubukhulu bami, ungiduduze inhlangothi zonke.

Izakwehla njengezulu etshanini obugundiweyo, njengezihlambo ezithambisa umhlaba.

Kayibongwe iNkosi uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu kaIsrayeli, onguye yedwa owenza imimangaliso.

Ngoba kakulazibopho ekufeni kwabo, kodwa amandla abo aqinile.

Kodwa mina ngihlezi ngilawe; ubambe isandla sami sokunene.

Ngoba khangela, abakhatshana lawe bazabhubha; ubachithile bonke abaphingayo ngokusuka kuwe.

Wena, wena uyesabeka. Ngubani-ke ongema phambi kwakho kusukela esikhathini solaka lwakho?

Ngakho badla basutha kakhulu, ngoba wabalethela isiloyiso sabo.

Siphendule, Nkulunkulu wamabandla, wenze ubuso bakho bukhanye, ngakho sizasindiswa.

Nkosi, Nkulunkulu wamabandla, siphendule, wenze ubuso bakho bukhanye, ngakho sizasindiswa.

Yenza encekwini yakho ngokomusa wakho, ungifundise izimiso zakho.
Ngiyinceku yakho; ngiphe ukuqedisisa, ukuze ngazi izifakazelo zakho.
Sekuyisikhathi seNkosi sokuthi isebenze, ngoba bawephule umlayo wakho.
Ngakho-ke ngiyayithanda imithetho yakho kakhulu kulegolide, yebo, kulegolide elicwengekileyo.
Ngalokho imithetho yakho yonke mayelana lazo zonke izinto ngiyibona iqondile; yonke indlela yamanga ngiyayizonda.
Izifakazelo zakho ziyamangalisa; ngakho-ke umphefumulo wami uyazigcina.
Ukuvulwa kwamazwi akho kuyakhanyisa, kunika ukuqedisisa kwabangelalwazi.
Ngavula umlomo wami, ngaphefuzela, ngoba ngalangazelela imithetho yakho.
Phendukela kimi, ube lomusa kimi, njengomkhuba kulabo abathanda ibizo lakho.
Qinisa izinyathelo zami ngelizwi lakho, njalo kabungabusi phezu kwami labubi.
Ngikhulula kucindezelo lwabantu, ukuze ngigcine imithetho yakho.
Khanyisa ubuso bakho phezu kwenceku yakho, ungifundise izimiso zakho.
Imifula yamanzi iyehla emehlweni ami, ngoba kabagcini umlayo wakho.
Wena, Nkosi, ulungile, ziqondile izahlulelo zakho.
Ulayile izifakazelo zakho ekulungeni lekuthembekeni okukhulu.
Ukutshiseka kwami kungiqedile, ngoba izitha zami zikhohlwe amazwi akho.
Ilizwi lakho licwengekile kakhulu; ngakho inceku yakho iyalithanda.
Ngimncinyane, ngidelelekile; imithetho yakho kangiyikhohlwa.
Ukulunga kwakho kuyikulunga kuze kube phakade, lomlayo wakho uliqiniso.
Ucindezelo lohlupho kungifumene; imithetho yakho izintokozo zami.
Ukulunga kwezifakazelo zakho kungokwaphakade; ngiphe ukuqedisisa ukuze ngiphile.
Ngakhala ngenhliziyo yami yonke; ngiphendula, Nkosi. Ngizagcina izimiso zakho.
Ngikhalela kuwe; ngisindisa, njalo ngizagcina izifakazelo zakho.
Ngandulela uvivi, ngakhala; ngathembela elizwini lakho.
Amehlo ami aqalela imilindo yobusuku, ukuze ngizindle elizwini lakho.
Zwana ilizwi lami ngokomusa wakho; Nkosi, ngivuselela ngokwesahlulelo sakho.
Bayasondela abazingeli bobubi, bakhatshana lomlayo wakho.
Wena useduze, Nkosi, lemithetho yakho yonke iliqiniso.
Sekukade ngisazi ngemilayo yakho ukuthi uyisekele kuze kube nininini.
Khangela ukuhlupheka kwami, ungikhulule, ngoba kangiwukhohlwa umlayo wakho.
Mela udaba lwami, ungihlenge; ngivuselela ngokwelizwi lakho.
Usindiso lukhatshana lababi, ngoba kabadingi izimiso zakho.
Izihawu zakho, Nkosi, zinkulu; ngivuselela ngokwezahlulelo zakho.
Banengi abangizingelayo labayizitha zami; kangiphambuki ezifakazelweni zakho.
Ngabona abaphambuki, ngacunuka, ngoba kabagcinanga ilizwi lakho.
Bona ukuthi ngiyayithanda imithetho yakho. Ngivuselela, Nkosi, ngokothandolomusa wakho.
Ilizwi lakho liliqiniso kwasekuqaleni, laso sonke isahlulelo sakho esilungileyo simi kuze kube nininini.
Iziphathamandla zingizingela kungelasizatho; kodwa inhliziyo yami ilovalo ngamazwi akho.
Ngiyathokoza ngelizwi lakho njengothole impango enkulu.
Amanga ngiyawazonda ngiyawenyanya; umlayo wakho ngiyawuthanda.
Kasikhombisa ngosuku ngiyakudumisa ngenxa yezahlulelo zakho ezilungileyo.
Balokuthula okukhulu abathanda umlayo wakho; njalo kakulasikhubekiso kubo.
Ngilindele usindiso lwakho, Nkosi, ngiyayenza imithetho yakho.
Umphefumulo wami uyazigcina izifakazelo zakho, ngiyazithanda kakhulu.
Ngiyagcina imithetho yakho lezifakazelo zakho, ngoba zonke indlela zami ziphambi kwakho.
Ukukhala kwami kakusondele kuwe, Nkosi; ngiphe ukuqedisisa ngokwelizwi lakho.
Ukuncenga kwami kakufike phambi kwakho; ngikhulula ngokwelizwi lakho.
Indebe zami zizathulula indumiso, ngoba ungifundisile izimiso zakho.
Ulimi lwami luzakhuluma ilizwi lakho, ngoba yonke imithetho yakho iyikulunga.
Isandla sakho kasibe lusizo lwami, ngoba ngikhethile imithetho yakho.
Ngiyalangazelela usindiso lwakho, Nkosi, lomlayo wakho uyintokozo yami.
Kawuphile umphefumulo wami, njalo uzakudumisa, lezahlulelo zakho zingisize.
Ngiduhile njengemvu elahlekileyo; dinga inceku yakho, ngoba kangikhohlwa imithetho yakho.
Ekuhluphekeni kwami ngakhala eNkosini, yangiphendula.
Nkosi, khulula umphefumulo wami kundebe zamanga, kulimi lwenkohliso.
Uzanikwani, njalo kuzakwengezelelwani kuwe, limi lwenkohliso?
Imitshoko ebukhali yeqhawe, lamalahle avuthayo esihlahla serotemu*!
Maye kimi, ngoba ngihlala njengowezizwe koMesheki, ngihlala emathenteni eKedari!
Umphefumulo wami sekukade wahlala laye ozonda ukuthula.
Ngingowokuthula, kodwa lapho ngikhuluma, bangabempi.
Ngizaphakamisela amehlo ami ezintabeni, lapho usizo lwami oluzavela khona.
Usizo lwami luvela eNkosini, eyenza amazulu lomhlaba.
Kayiyikuvuma ukuthi unyawo lwakho lutshelele; umlondolozi wakho kayikuwozela.
Khangela, umlondolozi kaIsrayeli kayikuwozela njalo kayikulala.
INkosi ingumlondolozi wakho; iNkosi ingumthunzi wakho esandleni sakho sokunene.
Ilanga kaliyikukutshaya emini, lenyanga ebusuku.
INkosi izakulondoloza kukho konke okubi; izalondoloza umphefumulo wakho.
INkosi izalondoloza ukuphuma kwakho lokungena kwakho, kusukela khathesi kuze kube phakade.
Ngathokoza lapho besithi kimi: Kasiye endlini yeNkosi.
Inyawo zethu zimi emasangweni akho, Jerusalema.
IJerusalema yakhiwe njengomuzi ohlangeneyo ngokwawo,
lapho izizwe ezenyukela khona, izizwe zeNkosi, kubufakazi bukaIsrayeli, ukuze zibonge ibizo leNkosi.
Ngoba kumiswe khona izihlalo zobukhosi zesahlulelo, izihlalo zobukhosi zendlu kaDavida.
Khulekelani ukuthula kweJerusalema; bazaphumelela abakuthandayo.
Kakube khona ukuthula phakathi kwemiduli yakho, inhlalakahle ezigodlweni zakho.
Ngenxa yabafowethu labangane bami sengizakuthi: Ukuthula kakube phakathi kwakho.
Ngenxa yendlu yeNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu ngizakudingela okuhle.
Ngiyaphakamisela kuwe amehlo ami, wena ohlezi emazulwini.

Khangela, njengalokhu amehlo ezinceku engasesandleni senkosi yazo, njengamehlo encekukazi engasesandleni senkosikazi yayo, ngokunjalo amehlo ethu angaseNkosini uNkulunkulu wethu, ize ibe lesihawu kithi.
Woba lesihawu kithi, Nkosi, woba lesihawu kithi, ngoba sigcwele kakhulu yikudelelwa.
Umphefumulo wethu ugcwele kakhulu yikukloloda kwabonwabileyo, yikudelela kwabazigqajayo.
Uba kwakungesiNkosi eyayilathi, katsho-ke uIsrayeli;
uba kwakungesiNkosi eyayilathi, lapho abantu besivukela,
ngabe basiginya siphila, ekuvutheni kolaka lwabo kithi;
ngabe amanzi agijima phezu kwethu, lempophoma yedlula phezu komphefumulo wethu;
ngabe amanzi aqubukayo edlula phezu komphefumulo wethu.
Kayibongwe iNkosi, engasinikelanga ukuthi sibe yimpango emazinyweni abo.
Umphefumulo wethu uphunyukile njengenyoni emjibileni wabathiyi; umjibila uqamukile, thina sasesiphunyuka.
Usizo lwethu lusebizweni leNkosi eyenza amazulu lomhlaba.
Labo abathembela eNkosini banjengentaba iZiyonienganyikinyekiyo, emi kuze kube phakade.
Njengezintaba ziyiphahlile iJerusalema, ngokunjalo iNkosi iyabaphahla abantu bayo kusukela kulesisikhathi kuze kube nininini.
Ngoba intonga yobukhosi yobubi kayiyikuhlala phezu kwesabelo sabalungileyo, ukuze abalungileyo bangeluleli izandla zabo kokubi.
Nkosi, yenza okuhle kubo abalungileyo lakubo abaqotho enhliziyweni zabo.
Kodwa labo abaphambukela ezindleleni zabo ezitshekileyo iNkosi izabenza bahambe labenzi bobubi. Ukuthula phezu kukaIsrayeli!
Lapho iNkosi ibuyisa abathunjiweyo beZiyoni, saba njengabaphuphayo.
Umlomo wethu wasugcwala uhleko, lolimi lwethu ukuhlabelela. Basebesithi phakathi kwezizwe: INkosi ibenzele izinto ezinkulu.
INkosi isenzele izinto ezinkulu; siyathokoza.
Buyisa, Nkosi, ukuthunjwa kwethu, njengezifula zeningizimu.
Abahlanyela ngezinyembezi bazavuna ngentokozo.
Yena ohamba ahambe ekhala inyembezi, ephethe inhlanyelo yokuhlanyela, isibili uzabuya ethokoza, ethwele inyanda zakhe.
Uba iNkosi ingayakhi indlu, basebenzela ize kiyo abayakhayo. Uba iNkosi ingawulondolozi umuzi, umlindi ulindela ize.
Kuyize kini ukuthi livuke ngovivi, lihlale kuze kube sebusuku, lidle ukudla kosizi; ngokunjalo iyamnika ubuthongo othandiweyo wayo.
Khangela, abantwana bayilifa leNkosi, isithelo sesizalo singumvuzo.
Njengemitshoko esandleni seqhawe, banjalo abantwana bobutsha.
Ibusisiwe indoda egcwalise umxhaka wayo ngabo; kabayikuyangeka ngoba bazakhuluma lezitha esangweni.
Ubusisiwe wonke oyesabayo iNkosi, ohamba endleleni zayo.
Ngoba uzakudla umsebenzi wezandla zakho; uzathokoza, njalo kuzakuba kuhle kuwe.
Umkakho uzakuba njengevini elithelayo emaceleni endlu yakho, abantwana bakho bazakuba njengamahlumela omhlwathi bezingelezele itafula lakho.
Ngoba khangela, ngokunjalo izabusiswa indoda eyesabayo iNkosi.
INkosi izakubusisa iseZiyoni, njalo ubone okuhle kweJerusalema insuku zonke zempilo yakho,
yebo, uzabona abantwana babantwana bakho. Ukuthula kakube phezu kukaIsrayeli!
Kanengi bangihluphile kusukela ebutsheni bami, katsho-ke uIsrayeli,
kanengi bangihluphile kusukela ebutsheni bami, kanti kabangehlulanga.
Abalimi balima emhlana wami, bayenza yaba mide imifolo yabo.
INkosi ilungile, iqumile intambo zababi.
Kabayangeke babuyiselwe emuva bonke abazonda iZiyoni.
Kababe njengotshani ephahleni, obubuna bungakakhuli,
ovunayo angagcwalisi ngabo isandla sakhe, lalowo obopha izithungo isifuba sakhe.
Labadlulayo bangatsho ukuthi: Isibusiso seNkosi kasibe phezu kwenu; siyalibusisa ebizweni leNkosi.
Ngisenzikini ngakhalela kuwe, Nkosi.
Nkosi, zwana ilizwi lami, indlebe zakho zilalele ilizwi lokuncenga kwami.
Uba wena, Nkosi, uqaphela iziphambeko, Nkosi, ngubani ongema?
Kodwa kuwe kulothethelelo, ukuze wesatshwe.
Ngiyilindele iNkosi, umphefumulo wami ulindile, lelizwini layo ngiyathemba.
Umphefumulo wami ulindela iNkosi okwedlula abalindele ukusa, belindele ukusa.
UIsrayeli kathembele eNkosini; ngoba eNkosini kulothandolomusa, njalo kuyo kulohlengo olunengi.
Yona-ke izahlenga uIsrayeli kuzo zonke iziphambeko zakhe.
Nkosi, inhliziyo yami kayikhukhumali, lamehlo ami kawaphakami, njalo kangihambi ezintweni ezinkulu lezintweni ezimangalisayo kakhulu kimi.
Sibili ngichumisile ngathulisa umphefumulo wami, njengolunyuliweyo kunina; umphefumulo wami unjengolunyuliweyo phakathi kwami.
UIsrayeli kathembele eNkosini kusukela khathesi kuze kube laphakade.
Khumbula, Nkosi, uDavida, izinhlupheko zakhe zonke,
ukuthi wafunga eNkosini, wathembisa kuSomandla kaJakobe:
Qotho, kangiyikungena ethenteni lendlu yami, qotho, kangiyikwenyukela ecansini lombheda wami;
qotho, kangiyikunika amehlo ami ubuthongo, ukuwozela ezinkopheni zami,
ngize ngiyitholele iNkosi indawo, indawo zokuhlala uSomandla kaJakobe.
Khangela, sakuzwa eEfratha, sakuthola emasimini egusu.
Sizangena ezindlini zayo zokuhlala, sikhonze esenabelweni senyawo zayo.
Sukuma, Nkosi, uye ekuphumuleni kwakho, wena lomtshokotsho wamandla akho!
Abapristi bakho kabembeswe ukulunga, labangcwele bakho bathabe kakhulu.
Ngenxa yenceku yakho uDavida ungafulathelisi ubuso bogcotshiweyo wakho.
INkosi yafunga ngeqiniso kuDavida, kayiyikubuyela emuva kilo: Owesithelo sesizalo sakho ngizambeka esihlalweni sakho sobukhosi.
Uba abantwana bakho begcina isivumelwano sami lezifakazelo zami engizabafundisa zona, labantwana babo bazahlala esihlalweni sakho sobukhosi kuze kube nini lanini.
Ngoba iNkosi iyikhethile iZiyoni, iyifisile ibe yindawo yayo yokuhlala.
Le yindawo yami yokuphumula kuze kube nini lanini; lapha ngizahlala, ngoba ngiyifisile.
Ngizabusisa kakhulu ukudla kwayo, ngisuthise abayanga bayo ngesinkwa.
Labapristi bayo ngizabembathisa usindiso, labangcwele bayo bazahlabelela kakhulu ngenjabulo.
Lapho ngizahlumisa uphondo lukaDavida; ngimisele ogcotshiweyo wami isibane.
Izitha zakhe ngizazembathisa ihlazo, kodwa phezu kwakhe uzakhazimula umqhele wakhe wobukhosi.
Khangela, kuhle kangakanani njalo kumnandi kangakanani ukuhlala kwabazalwane ndawonye ngitsho babe munye.
Kufanana lamafutha amahle phezu kwekhanda, ehlela endevini, indevu zikaAroni, ehlele emphethweni wezembatho zakhe,
njengamazolo eHermoni, ehlela entabeni zeZiyoni; ngoba lapho iNkosi yalaya isibusiso, impilo kuze kube phakade.
Khangelani, libonge iNkosi lina lonke zinceku zeNkosi, elimi endlini yeNkosi ebusuku.
Phakamiselani izandla zenu endaweni engcwele, libonge iNkosi.
INkosi eyenza amazulu lomhlaba kayilibusise iseZiyoni.
Dumisani iNkosi! Dumisani ibizo leNkosi, dumisani lina zinceku zeNkosi,
elimi endlini yeNkosi, emagumeni endlu kaNkulunkulu wethu.
Dumisani iNkosi, ngoba iNkosi ilungile; hlabelelani indumiso ebizweni layo, ngoba kumnandi.
Ngoba iNkosi izikhethele uJakobe, uIsrayeli abe ngokuligugu kwakhe okukhethekileyo.
Ngoba mina ngiyazi ukuthi iNkosi inkulu, ukuthi iNkosi yethu iphezu kwabo bonke onkulunkulu.
Konke iNkosi ekuthandayo iyakwenza, emazulwini lemhlabeni, ezinlwandle lenzikini zonke.
Yenza izinkungu zenyuke emikhawulweni yomhlaba, yenzela izulu imibane, ikhupha umoya eziphaleni zayo.
Eyatshaya izibulo leGibhithe, kusukela emuntwini kuze kube senyamazaneni.
Yathumela izibonakaliso lezimangaliso phakathi kwakho, Gibhithe, phezu kukaFaro laphezu kwenceku zakhe zonke.
Eyatshaya izizwe ezinengi, yabulala amakhosi alamandla,
uSihoni inkosi yamaAmori, loOgi inkosi yeBashani, layo yonke imibuso yeKhanani,
yanikela ilizwe labo laba yilifa, ilifa likaIsrayeli, isizwe sayo.
Nkosi, ibizo lakho limi kuze kube phakade, ukukhunjulwa kwakho, Nkosi, kusizukulwana ngesizukulwana.
Ngoba iNkosi izakwehlulela abantu bayo, izazisola mayelana lezinceku zayo.
Izithombe zezizwe ziyisiliva legolide, umsebenzi wezandla zomuntu.
Zilemilomo, kodwa kazikhulumi; zilamehlo, kodwa kaziboni;
zilendlebe, kodwa kazizwa; lomoya kawukho emlonyeni wazo.
Abazenzayo bafanana lazo, laye wonke othembela kuzo.
Wena ndlu kaIsrayeli, bongani iNkosi; wena ndlu kaAroni, bongani iNkosi;
wena ndlu kaLevi, bongani iNkosi. Lina eliyesabayo iNkosi, bongani iNkosi.
Kayibongwe iNkosi iseZiyoni, ehlala eJerusalema. Dumisani iNkosi!
Bongani iNkosi ngoba ilungile, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Bongani uNkulunkulu wabonkulunkulu, ngoba isihawu sakhe simi kuze kube nininini.
Bongani iNkosi yamakhosi, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Yona yodwa eyenza izimangaliso ezinkulu, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
eyenza amazulu ngokuhlakanipha, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
eyendlala umhlaba phezu kwamanzi, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
eyenza izikhanyiso ezinkulu, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
ilanga ukubusa emini, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
inyanga lezinkanyezi ukubusa ebusuku, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Yona eyatshaya amaGibhithe kumazibulo awo, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
yakhupha uIsrayeli phakathi kwabo, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
ngesandla esilamandla langengalo eyeluliweyo, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Yona eyehlukanisa uLwandle oluBomvu lwaba yiziqamu, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
yenza uIsrayeli adabule phakathi kwalo, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
kodwa yathintithela uFaro lebutho lakhe oLwandle oluBomvu, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Yona eyakhokhela abantu bayo enkangala, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Yona eyatshaya amakhosi amakhulu, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
yabulala amakhosi adumileyo, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
uSihoni inkosi yamaAmori, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
loOgi inkosi yeBashani, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
yanika ilizwe labo laba yilifa, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
ilifa kuIsrayeli inceku yayo, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Eyasikhumbula ebuphansini bethu, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini;
yasophula ezitheni zethu, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Enika yonke inyama ukudla, ngoba isihawu sayo simi kuze kube nininini.
Bongani uNkulunkulu wamazulu, ngoba isihawu sakhe simi kuze kube nininini.
Emifuleni yeBhabhiloni sahlala phansi khona, yebo sakhala inyembezi, lapho sikhumbula iZiyoni.
Amachacho ethu sawaphanyeka eminyezaneni phakathi kwayo.
Ngoba khonapho abasithumbayo basicela amazwi engoma, labasimotshayo bacela injabulo besithi: Sihlabeleleni enye yezingoma zeZiyoni.
Singahlabela njani ingoma yeNkosi elizweni lemzini?
Uba ngikukhohlwa, Jerusalema, isandla sami sokunene kasikhohlwe ubungcitshi.
Ulimi lwami kalunamathele elwangeni lwami, uba ngingakukhumbuli, uba ngingaphakamisi iJerusalema phezu kwentokozo yami enkulu.
Khumbula, Nkosi, ngabantwana bakoEdoma, ngosuku lweJerusalema, abathi: Dilizani, dilizani, kuze kube sesisekelweni sayo.
Ndodakazi yeBhabhiloni, ozabhujiswa, ubusisiwe ozaphindisela kuwe isenzo osenze kithi.
Ubusisiwe ozabamba asakaze abantwana bakho edwaleni.
Ngizakubonga ngenhliziyo yami yonke; phambi kwabonkulunkulu ngizakuhlabelela indumiso.
Ngizakhonza ngikhangele ngasethempelini lakho elingcwele, ngidumise ibizo lakho ngenxa yothando lwakho langenxa yobuqotho bakho; ngoba ukhulisile ilizwi lakho phezu kwalo lonke ibizo lakho.
Ngosuku engakhala ngalo wangiphendula, wangiqinisa ngamandla emphefumulweni wami.
Wonke amakhosi omhlaba azakudumisa, Nkosi, ngoba azwile amazwi omlomo wakho.
Yebo, azahlabelela ngezindlela zeNkosi, ngoba lukhulu udumo lweNkosi.
Loba iNkosi iphakeme, kube kanti iyabona othobekileyo; kodwa ozigqajayo iyamazi ekhatshana.
Loba ngihamba phakathi kwenhlupheko, uzangiphilisa; uzakwelula isandla sakho umelana lolaka lezitha zami, lesandla sakho sokunene sizangisindisa.
INkosi izaphelelisa okumayelana lami; uthando lwakho, Nkosi, lumi kuze kube nininini. Ungatshiyi imisebenzi yezandla zakho.
Nkosi, ungihlolile, uyangazi.
Wena uyakwazi ukuhlala kwami lokusukuma kwami; uyaqedisisa imicabango yami ukhatshana.
Uyahlungula ukuhamba kwami lokulala kwami, uzejwayele indlela zami zonke.
Ngoba kalikho ilizwi elimini lwami, khangela Nkosi, usulazi lonke.
Ungizingelezile emuva langaphambili, ubeke isandla sakho phezu kwami.
Lolulwazi lumangalisa kakhulu kimi; luphakeme, kangilakho ukufinyelela kulo.
Ngizakuya ngaphi ngisuke kuMoya wakho? Kumbe ngizabalekela ngaphi ngisuke ebusweni bakho?
Uba ngisenyukela emazulwini, lapho ukhona; uba ngisendlala icansi lami esihogweni, khangela, ukhona.
Uba ngithatha amaphiko okusa, ngihlale emikhawulweni yolwandle,
lalapho isandla sakho sizangikhokhela, lesokunene sakho singibambe.
Uba ngisithi: Isibili umnyama uzangifihla, ngitsho ubusuku buzakuba yikukhanya kimi inhlangothi zonke.
Ngitsho umnyama kawufihli kuwe, kodwa ubusuku bukhanya njengemini; njengomnyama kunjalo ukukhanya kuwe.
Ngoba wena ungumnini wezinso zami, wangeluka esiswini sikamama.
Ngizakudumisa, ngenxa yokuthi ngenziwe ngokwesabekayo, ngokumangalisayo. Imisebenzi yakho iyamangalisa; lomphefumulo wami uyakwazi kuhle kakhulu.
Amathambo ami ayengafihlekanga kuwe, lapho ngangisenziwa ekusithekeni, ngenziwa ngobuciko ezindaweni ezizikileyo zomhlaba.
Amehlo akho abona ibumba lami; legwalweni lwakho zonke lezi zabhalwa, izinsuku okwabunjwa ngazo, kungakabikho lakunye kwakho.
Iligugu kangakanani-ke kimi imicabango yakho, O Nkulunkulu; bukhulu kangakanani ubunengi bayo!
Uba ngingayibala, minengi kuletshebetshebe. Lapho ngivuka, ngilokhu ngilawe.
Isibili uzambulala omubi, Nkulunkulu! Ngakho lina bantu abomele igazi sukani kimi;
abakhuluma ngenkohliso ngawe, ziphatha ngeze ibizo lakho, izitha zakho.
Kangibazondi yini, Nkosi, abakuzondayo, nginengwe ngabakuvukelayo?
Ngiyabazonda ngenzondo epheleleyo; sebeyizitha kimi.
Ngihlola, Nkulunkulu, uyazi inhliziyo yami; ngilinga, uyazi imicabango yami,
ubone ukuthi ikhona indlela embi kimi yini, ungikhokhele endleleni ephakade.
Ngikhulula, Nkosi, emuntwini omubi, ungilondoloze emuntwini olesihluku,
abaceba izinto ezimbi enhliziyweni, usuku lonke babuthanela izimpi.
Balola ulimi lwabo njengenyoka, ubuhlungu bebululu bungaphansi kwendebe zabo. Sela*.
Ngilondoloze, Nkosi, ezandleni zomubi, ungivikele emuntwini olesihluku; abaceba ukuwisa inyawo zami.
Abazigqajayo bangifihlele umjibila, lezintambo, bendlala imbule eceleni kwendlela; bangibekela izithiyo. Sela*.
Ngithe eNkosini: Wena unguNkulunkulu wami. Beka indlebe elizwini lokuncenga kwami, Nkosi.
Jehova, Nkosi, mandla osindiso lwami, wembese ikhanda lami osukwini lwezikhali.
Unganiki, Nkosi, izifiso zomubi, ungaphumelelisi icebo lakhe elibi, hlezi baziphakamise. Sela*.
Ngekhanda labangihanqileyo, ububi bendebe zabo kabubembese.
Kakuthi amalahle atshisayo akhithikele phezu kwabo, ubawisela emlilweni, emigodini etshonayo, ukuze bangavuki.
Umuntu wolimi kangamiswa elizweni; umuntu olesihluku, ububi buzamzingela kube yikuwiswa kwakhe.
Ngiyazi ukuthi iNkosi izasebenza udaba lohluphekayo, ilungelo labayanga.
Isibili abalungileyo bazalidumisa ibizo lakho; abaqotho bazahlala ebusweni bakho.
Nkosi, ngiyakhala kuwe; phangisa uze kimi; beka indlebe elizwini lami lapho ngikhala kuwe.
Umkhuleko wami kawumiswe njengempepha phambi kwakho, ukuphakanyiswa kwezandla zami njengomnikelo wakusihlwa.
Nkosi, bekela umlomo wami umlindi, gcina umnyango wendebe zami.
Ungaphenduleli inhliziyo yami entweni embi, ukuthi ngenze izenzo ezimbi kanye labantu abenza ububi, ngingadli ezibilibocweni zabo.
Olungileyo kangitshaye ethandwenilomusa, angisole; kuzakuba ngamafutha ekhanda, ikhanda lami kalingawali, ngoba lomkhuleko wami usezakuba sezinhluphekweni zabo.
Abahluleli babo baphoselwa emaceleni edwala, bazakuzwa amazwi ami ngoba amnandi.
Amathambo ethu ahlakazekile emlonyeni wengcwaba njengobandayo adabule emhlabathini.
Kodwa amehlo ami akuwe, Jehova, Nkosi; ngithembele kuwe; ungawuchayi umphefumulo wami.
Ngigcina emandleni omjibila abangibekele wona, lezithiyo zabenzi bobubi.
Ababi kabawele emambuleni abo kanye, ngize ngidlule mina.
Ngakhalela eNkosini ngelizwi lami, ngelizwi lami eNkosini ngancenga.
Ngathulula isikhalazo sami phambi kwayo, ngatshengisa ukuhlupheka kwami phambi kwayo.
Lapho umoya wami uphela amandla phakathi kwami, wena wayazi indlela yami. Endleleni engihamba ngayo bangifihlele umjibila.
Khangela ngakwesokunene, ubone, kodwa wayengekho ongaziyo; isiphephelo sangehlula, kakho owakhathalela umphefumulo wami.
Ngakhalela kuwe, Nkosi, ngathi: Wena uyisiphephelo sami, isabelo sami elizweni labaphilayo.
Lalela ukukhala kwami, ngoba ngehliselwe phansi kakhulu. Ngikhulula kwabangizingelayo, ngoba balamandla kulami.
Khupha umphefumulo wami entolongweni, ukuze ngidumise ibizo lakho. Abalungileyo bazangibuthanela, ngoba uzangiphatha kuhle kakhulu.
Nkosi, zwana umkhuleko wami, ubeke indlebe ekuncengeni kwami. Ungiphendule ngothembeko lwakho, ngokulunga kwakho.
Njalo ungangeni kusahlulelo lenceku yakho, ngoba phambi kobuso bakho kakho ophilayo ozalungisiswa.
Ngoba isitha sizingele umphefumulo wami, sacindezelela impilo yami emhlabathini, sangenza ngahlala emnyameni omkhulu, njengabakade bafa.
Ngakho umoya wami uphela amandla phakathi kwami, lenhliziyo yami ithithibele phakathi kwami.
Ngikhumbula insuku zekadeni, ngizindla ngazo zonke izenzo zakho, nginakane ngomsebenzi wezandla zakho.
Ngelulela izandla zami kuwe; umphefumulo wami womele wena njengomhlaba owomileyo. Sela*.
Phangisa ungiphendule, Nkosi; umoya wami uyaphela. Ungangifihleli ubuso bakho, hlezi ngibe njengalabo abehlela emgodini.
Ngizwisa uthandolomusa wakho ekuseni, ngoba ngiyathemba kuwe. Ungazise indlela engingahamba ngayo, ngoba ngiyaphakamisela kuwe umphefumulo wami.
Ngikhulula ezitheni zami, Nkosi; ngizifihlile kuwe.
Ngifundisa ukwenza intando yakho, ngoba wena unguNkulunkulu wami. UMoya wakho muhle, ngikhokhelele elizweni lokuqonda.
Ngenxa yebizo lakho, Nkosi, ngiphilisa. Ngokulunga kwakho khupha umphefumulo wami ekuhluphekeni.
Langomusa wakho chitha izitha zami, ubhubhise bonke abahlupha umphefumulo wami, ngoba ngiyinceku yakho.
Kayibongwe iNkosi, idwala lami, efundisela izandla zami impi, iminwe yami ukulwa;
umusa wami, lenqaba yami, umphotshongo wami ophakemeyo, lomkhululi wami, isihlangu sami, lengiphephela kuyo, ethobisa abantu bami ngaphansi kwami.
Nkosi, umuntu uyini ukuthi umazi? Indodana yomuntu ukuthi uyinanze?
Umuntu unjengeze, insuku zakhe zinjengesithunzi esidlulayo.
Nkosi, khothamisa amazulu akho, wehle; thinta izintaba ukuze zithunqe.
Phazimisa umbane, ubachithe, uthumele imitshoko yakho, ubahlakaze.
Yelula isandla sakho uphezulu, ungikhulule, ungophule emanzini amanengi, esandleni sabantwana besizwe,
abamlomo wabo ukhuluma amanga, lesandla sabo sokunene singesokunene senkohliso.
Ngizahlabelela kuwe ingoma entsha, Nkulunkulu; ngizahlabelela indumiso kuwe ngogubhu olulentambo ezilitshumi.
Wena onika amakhosi usindiso, okhulula uDavida inceku yakho enkembeni embi.
Ngophula, ungikhulule esandleni sabantwana besizwe, abamlomo wabo ukhuluma amanga, lesandla sabo sokunene singesokunene senkohliso.
Ukuthi amadodana ethu abe njengezilimo ezikhula ebutsheni bazo, amadodakazi ethu njengamatshe engonsi abazwe njengomfanekiso wesigodlo!
Ukuthi iziphala zethu zigcwale ziveze uhlobo ngohlobo; izimvu zethu zizale izinkulungwane, yebo, izinkulungwane ezilitshumi emadlelweni ethu!
Ukuthi inkabi zethu zingathwaliswa, kungabi lokufohlela phakathi, njalo kungabi lokuphuma, kumbe kungabi lesililo ezitaladeni zethu!
Bayathaba abantu okunjalo kubo; bayathaba abantu abaNkulunkulu wabo yiNkosi.
Ngizakuphakamisa, Nkulunkulu wami, Nkosi, ngibonge ibizo lakho kuze kube nini lanini.
Ngensuku zonke ngizakubonga, ngidumise ibizo lakho kuze kube nini lanini.
Yinkulu iNkosi, ifanele ukudunyiswa kakhulu, lobukhulu bayo kabuhloleki.
Isizukulwana ngesizukulwana sizababaza imisebenzi yakho, sitshumayele izenzo zakho ezilamandla.
Ngizakhuluma ngodumo lwakho olukhazimulayo lobukhosi bakho, langendaba zezimangaliso zakho.
Njalo bazakhuluma ngamandla ezenzo zakho ezesabekayo, lobukhulu bakho ngibulandise.
Bazathulula ngamazwi isikhumbuzo sokulunga kwakho okukhulu, bahlabele ngentokozo ngokulunga kwakho.
Ilomusa lesihawu iNkosi, iyaphuza ukuthukuthela, inkulu ngothando.
INkosi ilungile kubo bonke, lezihawu zayo ziphezu kwayo yonke imisebenzi yayo.
Imisebenzi yakho yonke izakudumisa, Nkosi, labangcwele bakho bazakubusisa.
Bazakhuluma ngenkazimulo yombuso wakho, balandise ngamandla akho.
Ukuze bazise abantwana babantu izenzo zayo ezilamandla, lenkazimulo yobukhosi bombuso wayo.
Umbuso wakho ungumbuso wamaphakade wonke, lokubusa kwakho kumi kuso sonke isizukulwana ngesizukulwana.
INkosi isekela bonke abawayo, iphakamise bonke abakhothemeyo.
Amehlo abo bonke alindele kuwe, wena-ke uyabanika ukudla kwabo ngesikhathi sakho.
Uyavula isandla sakho, usuthise isifiso sakho konke okuphilayo.
INkosi ilungile endleleni zayo zonke, njalo ilomusa emisebenzini yayo yonke.
INkosi iseduze labo bonke abayibizayo, labo bonke abayibiza ngeqiniso.
Yenza isifiso sabayesabayo, iyezwa ukukhala kwabo, ibasindise.
INkosi iyabalondoloza bonke abayithandayo; kodwa bonke ababi izababhubhisa.
Umlomo wami uzakhuluma indumiso yeNkosi, layo yonke inyama ibonge ibizo layo elingcwele kuze kube nini lanini.
Dumisani iNkosi! Dumisa iNkosi, mphefumulo wami.
Ngizayidumisa iNkosi ngisaphila; ngizahlabelela indumiso kuNkulunkulu wami ngisesekhona.
Lingabeki ithemba lenu eziphathamandleni, endodaneni yomuntu okungekho kuyo usindiso.
Umoya wakhe uyaphuma, uyabuyela emhlabathini wakhe; ngalolosuku amacebo akhe ayaphela.
Ubusisiwe yena oloNkulunkulu kaJakobe ukuthi abe lusizo lwakhe, othemba lakhe liseNkosini uNkulunkulu wakhe,
owenza amazulu, lomhlaba, ulwandle, lakho konke okukukho, ogcina iqiniso kuze kube nininini,
owenzela abacindezelweyo isahlulelo, obaphayo ukudla abalambileyo. INkosi iyakhulula izibotshwa,
INkosi iyavula amehlo eziphofu; iNkosi iyabalulamisa abakhothemeyo; iNkosi iyabathanda abalungileyo.
INkosi ilondoloza abemzini, isekele intandane lomfelokazi; kodwa indlela yababi iyayigenqula.
INkosi izabusa kuze kube nininini, uNkulunkulu wakho, Ziyoni, kuze kube sesizukulwaneni ngesizukulwana. Dumisani iNkosi!
Dumisani iNkosi, ngoba kuhle ukuhlabelela indumiso kuNkulunkulu wethu, ngoba kumnandi, indumiso ifanele.
INkosi iyayakha iJerusalema, iqoqe abahlakaziweyo bakoIsrayeli.
Yelapha abadabukileyo enhliziyweni, ibophe izinsizi zabo.
Ibala inani lezinkanyezi, izibize zonke ngamabizo.
Yinkulu iNkosi yethu, njalo ngeyamandla amakhulu; ukuqedisisa kwayo kakulakunaniswa.
INkosi iyaphakamisa abamnene, iyabawisela emhlabathini ababi.
Hlabelelani eNkosini ngokubonga; lihlabele indumiso kuNkulunkulu wethu ngechacho.
Eyembesa amazulu ngamayezi, elungisela umhlaba izulu, ekhulisa utshani ezintabeni,
enika inyamazana ukudla kwazo, amaphuphu ewabayi akhalayo.
Kayithokozi ngamandla ebhiza, kayijabuleli imilenze yomuntu.
INkosi ijabulela abayesabayo, labo abathembela emuseni wayo.
Babaza iNkosi, Jerusalema. Dumisa uNkulunkulu wakho, Ziyoni.
Ngoba iqinise imigoqo yamasango akho; ibusise abantwana bakho phakathi kwakho.
Iyenza ukuthula emingceleni yakho; ikusuthise ngamanono engqoloyi.
Iyathumela umthetho wayo emhlabeni; ilizwi layo ligijima ngesiqubu esikhulu.
Enika iliqhwa elikhithikileyo njengoboya bezimvu; ihaze ungqwaqwane njengomlotha.
Iyaphosa isiqhotho sayo njengezigaqa; ngubani ongema phambi komqando wayo?
Iyathumela ilizwi layo, ikuncibilikise; ivunguzise umoya wayo, amanzi ageleze.
Iyamemezela ilizwi layo kuJakobe, izimiso zayo lezahlulelo zayo kuIsrayeli.
Kayenzanga njalo lakusiphi isizwe; lezahlulelo zayo kazizazi. Dumisani iNkosi!
Dumisani iNkosi! Dumisani iNkosi lisemazulwini, idumiseni endaweni eziphezulu.
Idumiseni lonke zingilosi zayo. Idumiseni lonke mabandla ayo.
Idumiseni langa lenyanga. Idumiseni lonke zinkanyezi ezikhanyayo.
Idumiseni mazulu amazulu, lani manzi aphezu kwamazulu.
Kakudumise ibizo leNkosi; ngoba yona yalaya, kwasekudalwa.
Yakumisa kuze kube nini lanini; yakhupha isimiso esingayikwedlula.
Dumisani iNkosi lisemhlabeni, migobho yolwandle, lani zinziki zonke,
mlilo lesiqhotho, liqhwa elikhithikileyo lenkungu, siphepho esenza ilizwi layo;
zintaba lamaqaqa wonke, zihlahla zezithelo lemisedari yonke,
zinyamazana zeganga lezifuyo zonke, zinto ezihuquzelayo lenyoni eziphaphayo.
Makhosi omhlaba, lani zizwe zonke, ziphathamandla, lani babusi bomhlaba,
majaha, lani-ke zintombi, maxhegu labatsha.
Kabadumise ibizo leNkosi, ngoba ibizo layo lodwa liphakeme; ubukhosi bayo buphezu komhlaba lamazulu.
Njalo iphakamisile uphondo lwabantu bayo, indumiso yabo bonke abangcwele bayo, eyabantwana bakoIsrayeli, abantu abaseduze layo. Dumisani iNkosi!
Dumisani iNkosi! HIabelelani iNkosi ingoma entsha, indumiso yayo ebandleni labangcwele.
UIsrayeli kathokoze ngoMenzi wakhe, abantwana beZiyoni kabathabe eNkosini yabo.
Kabadumise ibizo layo ngokusina, kabayihlabelele indumiso ngesigujana lechacho.
Ngoba iNkosi iyathokoza ngabantu bayo; izacecisa abamnene ngosindiso.
Abangcwele kabathokoze ngendumiso, kabahlabelele ngenjabulo emibhedeni yabo.
Indumiso zikaNkulunkulu zisemphinjeni wabo, lenkemba esika nhlangothi mbili esandleni sabo,
ukuze benze impindiselo phezu kwabahedeni, izijeziso phezu kwezizwe,
ukuze babophe amakhosi azo ngamaketane, lezikhulu zazo ngezibopho zensimbi,
ukuze benze isahlulelo esibhaliweyo phezu kwazo. Loludumo abangcwele bayo bonke balalo. Dumisani iNkosi!
Dumisani iNkosi! Dumisani uNkulunkulu endlini yakhe engcwele; mdumiseni emkhathini wamandla akhe.
Mdumiseni ngenxa yezenzo zakhe ezilamandla, limdumise ngenxa yobunengi bobukhulu bakhe.
Mdumiseni ngokuvuthelwa kophondo, limdumise ngogubhu lwezintambo lechacho,
limdumise ngesigujana langokusina, limdumise ngezinto zokuhlabelela ezilentambo langomhlanga,
limdumise ngensimbi ezincencethayo ezihlokomayo, limdumise ngensimbi ezincencethayo ezikhala kakhulu.
Konke okuphefumulayo kakudumise iNkosi. Dumisani iNkosi!
Izaga zikaSolomoni, indodana kaDavida, inkosi yakoIsrayeli;
ukwazi inhlakanipho lokulaywa, ukuqedisisa amazwi okuqedisisa,
ukwemukela ukulaya kwenhlakanipho, ukulunga, lesahlulelo, lokuqonda;
ukunika abangelalwazi inhlakanipho, ijaha ulwazi lengqondo.
Ohlakaniphileyo uzakuzwa, andise ukufunda, loqedisisayo uzazuza izeluleko,
ukuqedisisa isaga lomzekeliso, amazwi abahlakaniphileyo, lamalibho abo.
Ukwesaba iNkosi kuyikuqala kolwazi; izithutha ziyadelela inhlakanipho lokulaywa.
Ndodana yami, zwana ukulaya kukayihlo, ungawudeli umlayo kanyoko;
ngoba kuzakuba ngumqhele womusa ekhanda lakho, lemigaxo entanyeni yakho.
Ndodana yami, uba izoni zikuhuga, ungavumi.
Uba zisithi: Hamba lathi, siyecathamela igazi, sicatshele ongelacala kungelasizatho;
sibaginye bephila njengengcwaba, yebo, ngokupheleleyo, njengabehlela egodini.
Sizathola yonke impahla eligugu, sigcwalise izindlu zethu ngempango.
Phosela inkatho yakho phakathi kwethu; sonke sibe lesikhwama semali sinye.
Ndodana yami, ungahambi lazo endleleni; unqande unyawo lwakho emkhondweni wazo.
Ngoba inyawo zazo zigijimela ebubini, ziphangisa ukuchitha igazi.
Isibili, imbule lendlalelwa ize phambi kwamehlo aloba yiyiphi inyoni.
Lalaba bacathamela igazi labo, bacatshele imiphefumulo yabo.
Zinjalo indlela zakhe wonke ozuza inzuzo ngokuphanga; ithatha impilo yabaniniyo.
UkuHlakanipha kuyamemeza ngaphandle, kukhupha ilizwi lakho emidangeni.
Kuyamemeza endaweni eqakathekileyo yokuxokozela, ekungeneni kwamasango; emzini kutsho amazwi akho,
kusithi: Koze kube nini, lina elingelalwazi, lithanda ukungabi lalwazi, labaklolodayo bezifisela ukukloloda, leziphukuphuku zizonda ulwazi?
Phendukelani ekukhuzeni kwami; khangelani, ngizathululela umoya wami kini, ngilazise amazwi ami.
Ngoba ngibizile, kodwa lala; ngelulile isandla sami, kodwa kakho onanzayo;
ladelela sonke iseluleko sami, kalivumanga ukukhuza kwami;
mina-ke ngizahleka ukuchitheka kwenu, ngiklolode ekufikeni kokwesaba kwenu,
ekufikeni kokwesaba kwenu njengesiphepho, lokuchitheka kwenu kufika njengesivunguzane, lapho ubuhlungu losizi kulehlela.
Khona bazangibiza, kodwa kangiyikusabela; bazangidingisisa, kodwa kabayikungithola.
Ngenxa yokuthi babezonda ulwazi, bengakhethanga ukwesaba iNkosi.
Kabavumanga iseluleko sami, bedelela konke ukukhuza kwami.
Ngakho bazakudla okwesithelo sendlela yabo, basuthiswe ngamacebo abo.
Ngoba ukuhlehla kwabangelalwazi kuzababulala, lokonwaba kweziphukuphuku kuzababhubhisa.
Kodwa ongilalelayo uzahlala evikelekile, onwabe ekwesabeni okubi.
Ndodana yami, uba usemukela amazwi ami, ugcine kuwe imilayo yami,
ukuthi wenze indlebe yakho ilalele inhlakanipho, uthobise inhliziyo yakho ekuqedisiseni,
yebo, uba ukhalela ukuqedisisa, ukhuphele ilizwi lakho ekuzwisiseni,
uba ukudinga njengesiliva, ukuphenye njengezimpahla eziligugu ezifihliweyo,
khona uzaqedisisa ukuyesaba iNkosi, uthole ulwazi lukaNkulunkulu.
Ngoba iNkosi inika inhlakanipho; ulwazi lokuqedisisa kuvela emlonyeni wayo.
Iyababekela abaqotho inhlakanipho eqotho; iyisihlangu kubo abahamba ngokuqonda,
ukugcina indlela zesahlulelo; izalondoloza indlela zabangcwele bayo.
Khona uzaqedisisa ukulunga, lesahlulelo, lokuqonda; yonke indlela elungileyo.
Lapho inhlakanipho izangena enhliziyweni yakho, lolwazi lube mnandi emphefumulweni wakho;
ingqondo izakugcina, ukuqedisisa kukulondoloze;
ukukophula endleleni embi, emuntwini okhuluma izinto eziphambeneyo;
abatshiya indlela zobuqotho, ukuze bahambe ngendlela zobumnyama;
abathokoza ngokwenza okubi, bejabula ekuphambukeni komubi;
abandlela zabo ziphambene, begobile emikhondweni yabo;
ukukophula kowesifazana wemzini, kowezizwe okhohlisa ngamazwi akhe;
otshiya umngane wobutsha bakhe, ekhohlwa isivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu wakhe;
ngoba indlu yakhe itshonela ekufeni, lemikhondo yakhe emimoyeni efileyo.
Bonke abangena kuye kabayikubuya, njalo kabayikufinyelela endleleni zempilo.
Ukuze uhambe endleleni yabalungileyo, ugcine imikhondo yamalungisa.
Ngoba abaqotho bazahlala elizweni, labapheleleyo basale kulo;

Kulamacebo amanengi enhliziyweni yomuntu, kodwa iseluleko seNkosi sona sizakuma.

Ochitha uyise, axotshe unina, uyindodana ethelela inhloni ilethe ihlazo.
Yekela, ndodana yami, ukulalela ukulaywa, ukuphambuka emazwini olwazi.
Umfakazi omubi udelela isahlulelo, lomlomo wabakhohlakeleyo uginya ububi.

Kuludumo emuntwini ukuyekela inkani; kodwa sonke isiwula siyaziveza.

Iseluleko enhliziyweni yomuntu sinjengamanzi azikileyo, kodwa umuntu oqedisisayo uzasikha.
Inengi labantu limemezela, lowo lalowo ukulunga kwakhe, kodwa ngubani ongathola umuntu othembekileyo?

Ungathandi ubuthongo, hlezi ube ngumyanga; vula amehlo akho, usuthe isinkwa.
Kubi, kubi, kutsho umthengi; kodwa esehambile abesezincoma.
Kulegolide, lobunengi bamatshe aligugu, kodwa indebe zolwazi zingumceciso oligugu.
Thatha isembatho sakhe oyisibambiso sowemzini, umbambe abe yisibambiso sabezizwe.
Isinkwa samanga simnandi emuntwini, kodwa emva kwalokho umlomo wakhe uzagcwaliswa ngokhethe.
Imicabango uyimisa ngeseluleko; ngakho yenza impi ngamaqhinga amahle.
Ohambahamba enyeya wembula imfihlakalo; ngakho ungahlangani lokhohlisa ngendebe zakhe.
Othuka uyise loba unina, isibane sakhe sizacitshwa ebumnyameni obumnyama.
Ilifa lingaphangisiswa ekuqaleni, kodwa ukucina kwalo kakuyikubusiswa.
Ungathi: Ngizaphindisela okubi; lindela iNkosi, njalo izakusindisa.
Amatshe ezilinganiso ezehlukeneyo ayisinengiso eNkosini, lesikali esikhohlisayo kasilunganga.
Izinyathelo zomuntu zivela eNkosini; pho, umuntu angaqedisisa njani indlela yakhe?
Kungumjibila emuntwini ukuginya okungcwele, lokuhlolisisa emva kwezifungo.
Inkosi ehlakaniphileyo ihlakaza ababi, ibuyisela ivili phezu kwabo.
Umphefumulo womuntu uyisibane seNkosi, sihlolisisa wonke amakamelo esisu.
Umusa leqiniso kuyayigcina inkosi, isekela isihlalo sayo sobukhosi ngokulunga.
Udumo lwejaha lungamandla alo, lobukhosi babadala yizimvu zekhanda.
Imivimvinya yenxeba ihlanza ububi, ngokunjalo izidutshuzo zamakamelo esisu.
Inhliziyo yenkosi isesandleni sikaJehova injengezifula zamanzi; uyiphendulela loba ngaphi athanda khona.
Yonke indlela yomuntu ilungile emehlweni akhe, kodwa iNkosi ihlola izinhliziyo.
Ukwenza ukulunga lesahlulelo kukhethekile eNkosini kulomhlatshelo.
Ukuphakama kwamehlo, lokuzigqaja kwenhliziyo, lokulima kwabakhohlakeleyo, kuyisono.
Imicabango yokhutheleyo isenzuzweni kuphela, kodwa eyakhe wonke ophangisayo isekusweleni kuphela.
Ukwenza inotho ngolimi lwamanga kuyize eliphephukayo elalabo abadinga ukufa.
Isihluku sababi sizabahudula, ngoba besala ukwenza okulungileyo.
Indlela yomuntu igobile njalo ilecala, kodwa ohlanzekileyo, umsebenzi wakhe uqondile.
Kungcono ukuhlala engonsini yophahla kulalowesifazana wezinkani lendlini yokuhlanganyela.
Umphefumulo wokhohlakeleyo uloyisa ububi; umakhelwane wakhe kemukeli umusa emehlweni akhe.
Nxa isideleli sijeziswa, umuntu ongelalwazi uyahlakanipha; lalapho ohlakaniphileyo elaywa wemukela ulwazi.
Olungileyo uyananzelela indlu yokhohlakeleyo; uNkulunkulu uwisela abakhohlakeleyo ebubini.
Ogcika indlebe yakhe ekukhaleni komyanga, laye uzakhala angaphendulwa.
Isipho sensitha siyadedisa intukuthelo, lesivalamlomo esifubeni ulaka olulamandla.
Kuyintokozo kolungileyo ukwenza ukulunga, kodwa kuluvalo kubenzi bobubi.
Umuntu oduha endleleni yokuqedisisa uzahlala ebandleni lemimoya efileyo.
Othanda injabulo uzakuba ngumyanga; othanda iwayini lamafutha kayikunotha.
Okhohlakeleyo uyinhlawulelo yolungileyo, lesiphambeki esikhundleni sabaqotho.
Kungcono ukuhlala elizweni eliyinkangala kulalowesifazana wezingxabano lolaka.
Kukhona imfuyo eloyisekayo lamafutha emzini wohlakaniphileyo, kodwa umuntu oyisithutha uyakuginya.
Oxotshana lokulunga lomusa uzathola impilo, ukulunga, lodumo.
Ohlakaniphileyo ukhwela emzini wamaqhawe, adilizele phansi amandla ethemba lawo.
Ogcina umlomo wakhe lolimi lwakhe, ugcina umphefumulo wakhe ezinkathazweni.
Isideleli esizikhukhumezayo esizigqajayo libizo lakhe osebenza ngolaka lokuzikhukhumeza.
Isiloyiso sevila sizalibulala, ngoba izandla zalo ziyala ukusebenza.
Usuku lonke liloyisa isiloyiso, kodwa olungileyo uzakupha, angagodli.
Umhlatshelo wabakhohlakeleyo uyisinengiso; kakhulu kangakanani nxa bewuletha ngecebo elibi.
Umfakazi wamanga uzabhubha, kodwa umuntu olalelayo uzakhuluma njalonjalo.
Umuntu okhohlakeleyo wenza lukhuni ubuso bakhe, kodwa oqotho yena uyananzelela indlela yakhe.
Kakulanhlakanipho, njalo kakulakuqedisisa, njalo kakulaseluleko, okumelana leNkosi.
Ibhiza lilungiselwa usuku lwempi, kodwa ukukhululwa ngokweNkosi.
Ibizo elihle likhethekile kulenotho enengi; isisa esihle kulesiliva njalo kulegolide.
Onothileyo lomyanga bayahlangana; iNkosi yabenza bonke.
Ohlakaniphileyo ubona ububi acatshe, kodwa abangelalwazi bayaqhubeka babesebejeziswa.
Umvuzo wokuthobeka lokwesaba iNkosi kuyinotho lodumo lempilo.
Ameva lemijibila kusendleleni yabaphambeneyo; ogcina umphefumulo wakhe uzakuba khatshana labo.
Fundisa umntwana endleleni angahamba ngayo; ngitsho esemdala kayikuphambuka kuyo.
Onothileyo ubusa abayanga, lomeboleki uyisigqili somebolekisi.
Ohlanyela ukonakala uzavuna ukuhlupheka, lentonga yolaka lwakhe izaphela.
Olelihlo elilokuhle yena uzabusiswa, ngoba unikile okwesinkwa sakhe kumyanga.
Xotsha isideleli, kuzaphuma lenkani, yebo, ingxabano lehlazo kuzaphela.
Othanda ukuhlanzeka kwenhliziyo, ngenxa yesisa sendebe zakhe, inkosi ingumgane wakhe.
Amehlo eNkosi alondoloza ulwazi, kodwa izachitha amazwi abangathembekanga.
Ivila lithi: Kulesilwane ngaphandle; ngizabulawa phakathi kwezitalada.
Umlomo wabesifazana bemzini ungumgodi otshonayo; lowo iNkosi emthukutheleleyo uzawela khona.

Ocindezela umyanga ukwandisa alakho, opha onothileyo, isibili uzakuba ngoswelayo.
Beka indlebe yakho, uzwe amazwi abahlakaniphileyo, umise inhliziyo yakho elwazini lami.
Ngoba kumnandi uba uwalondoloza emibilini yakho; azahlala elungile kanyekanye endebeni zakho.
Ukuze ithemba lakho libe seNkosini, ngikwazisile wona lamuhla, ngitsho wena.
Kangikubhalelanga yini izinto ezinhle kakhulu kuzeluleko lelwazini?
Ukukwazisa ukuqiniseka kwamazwi eqiniso, ukuze ubuyisele amazwi eqiniso kulabo abakuthumileyo.
Ungamphangi umyanga ngoba engumyanga, njalo ungamchobozi oswelayo esangweni.
Ngoba iNkosi izamela udaba lwabo, iphange umphefumulo wababaphangayo.
Ungahlanganyeli lomuntu ololaka, ungahambisani lomuntu othukuthelayo,
hlezi ufunde indlela zakhe, wemukele umjibila emphefumulweni wakho.
Ungabi phakathi kwababambana izandla, phakathi kwabayizibambiso ngezikwelede.
Uba ungelakho okokuhlawula, kungani ezathatha umbheda wakho ngaphansi kwakho?
Ungatshedisi isikhonkwane esidala somngcele, oyihlo abasenzayo.
Uyambona yini umuntu oyingcitshi emsebenzini wakhe? Uzazimisa phambi kwamakhosi; kayikuzimisa phambi kwabantukazana.
Nxa uhlalela ukudla lesiphathamandla, qaphelisa lokuqaphelisa okuphambi kwakho.
Ubeke ingqamu emphinjeni wakho uba uyisiminzi.
Ungafisi izibondlo zaso, ngoba ziyikudla kwamanga.
Ungatshikatshikeli ukunotha; pheza ekuqedisiseni kwakho.
Uzandizisa yini amehlo akho kokungekho? Ngoba kuzazenzela lokuzenzela izimpiko njengokhozi oluphaphela emazulwini.
Ungadli ukudla kolelihlo elibi, ungafisi izibondlo zakhe.
Ngoba njengoba ecabangile emphefumulweni wakhe, unjalo. Uzakuthi: Dlana unathe; kodwa inhliziyo yakhe kayilawe.
Ucezu oludlileyo uzaluhlanza, wone amazwi akho amnandi.
Ungakhulumi endlebeni zoyisithutha, ngoba uzadelela inhlakanipho yamazwi akho.
Ungatshedisi isikhonkwane esidala somngcele; ungangeni emasimini ezintandane;
ngoba uMhlengi wazo ulamandla; yena uzamela udaba lwazo kuwe.
Beka inhliziyo yakho ekufundisweni, lezindlebe zakho emazwini olwazi.
Ungagodleli umntwana isijeziso; nxa umtshaya ngoswazi kayikufa.
Wena uzamtshaya ngoswazi, ukhulule umphefumulo wakhe esihogweni.
Ndodana yami, uba inhliziyo yakho ihlakanipha, inhliziyo yami izathokoza, yebo eyami;
lezinso zami zizajabula ekukhulumeni kwendebe zakho izinto eziqondileyo.
Inhliziyo yakho kayingahawukeli izoni; kodwa bana ekwesabeni iNkosi lonke usuku.
Ngoba isibili kukhona umvuzo, lomlindelo wakho kawuyikuqunywa.
Lalela wena, ndodana yami, uhlakaniphe, uqondise inhliziyo yakho endleleni.
Ungabi phakathi kwabanathi bewayini, phakathi kwezihwaba zenyama.
Ngoba isidakwa lesihwaba sizakuba ngumyanga, lokuwozela kugqokisa amadabudabu.
Lalela uyihlo owakuzalayo, ungamdeleli unyoko esemdala.
Thenga iqiniso, ungalithengisi; inhlakanipho, lemfundiso, lokuqedisisa.
Uyise wolungileyo uzathaba lokuthaba; lozala ohlakaniphileyo uzathokoza ngaye.
Uyihlo lonyoko kabathokoze, lokuzeleyo kathabe.
Ndodana yami, ngiphe inhliziyo yakho, lamehlo akho kawananzelele indlela zami.
Ngoba iwule lingumgodi otshonayo, lowesifazana owemzini ungumthombo ongumcingo.
Laye ucathama njengomphangi, andise abangathembekanga phakathi kwabantu.
Ngubani olo: Maye? Ngubani olo: Wo? Ngubani olenkani? Ngubani olesililo? Ngubani olamanxeba ngeze? Ngubani olamehlo abomvu?
Yilabo abalibala ewayinini, yilabo abazedinga iwayini elixutshanisiweyo.
Ungakhangeli iwayini, lapho lizibonakalisa libomvu, nxa linika umbala walo enkomitshini, lihamba liqondile.
Ekucineni kwalo liluma njengenyoka, lilume njengebululu.
Amehlo akho azabona abesifazana bemzini, lenhliziyo yakho ikhulume izinto eziphambeneyo.
Yebo, uzakuba njengolala enhliziyweni yolwandle, lanjengolala esihlokweni sensika yomkhumbi.
Bangitshayile, kangizwanga buhlungu; bangidutshuzile, kangikunanzanga. Ngizavuka nini? Ngiphinde ngilidinge futhi.
Ungabi lamhawu ngabantu ababi, ungaloyisi ukuba labo.
Ngoba inhliziyo yabo iceba udlakela, lezindebe zabo zikhuluma uhlupho.
Ngenhlakanipho indlu iyakhiwa, langokuqedisisa iqiniswe.
Langolwazi amakamelo agcwaliswa ngempahla zonke eziligugu lezimnandi.
Umuntu ohlakaniphileyo ulamandla, lomuntu ololwazi uqinisa amandla.
Ngoba ngezeluleko ezihlakaniphileyo ungalawula impi yakho, lokukhululwa kusebunengini babeluleki.
Inhlakanipho enkulu iphakeme esiwuleni; esangweni kasivuli umlomo waso.
Oceba ukwenza okubi, bazambiza ngokuthi ngumnikazi wamacebo amabi.
Umcabango wobuwula yisono, lesideleli siyisinengiso emuntwini.
Uba uzitshengisa uxega ngosuku lokuhlupheka, amandla akho mancinyane.
Bophule abasiwa ekufeni, labatatalikela ekubulaweni, kungathi ungabanqanda.
Uba usithi: Khangela besingakwazi lokhu; ohlola izinhliziyo yena kayikukunanzelela yini? Olondoloza umphefumulo wakho yena kakwazi yini? ngitsho ubuyisela emuntwini njengokomsebenzi wakhe?
Dlana uluju, ndodana yami, ngoba lulungile, lohlanga loluju lumnandi elwangeni lwakho.
Lunjalo ulwazi lwenhlakanipho emphefumulweni wakho; uba uluthola, kuzakuba lomvuzo, lethemba lakho kaliyikuqunywa.
Wena okhohlakeleyo, ungacathameli umuzi wolungileyo; ungachithi indawo yakhe yokuphumula.
Ngoba olungileyo uzakuwa kasikhombisa, avuke futhi; kodwa abakhohlakeleyo bazakhubeka ebubini.
Ungathokozi ngokuwa kwesitha sakho, lekukhubekeni kwaso inhliziyo yakho kayingajabuli;
hlezi iNkosi ikubone, kube kubi emehlweni ayo, iphendule ulaka lwayo ilususe kuso.
Ungazikhathazi ngenxa yabenzi bobubi, ungabi lamhawu ngabakhohlakeleyo;
ngoba omubi kayikuba lomvuzo; isibane sabakhohlakeleyo sizacitshwa.
Ndodana yami, yesaba uJehova lenkosi; ungahlanganyeli labaguquguqukayo;
ngoba incithakalo yabo izavuka masinyane; njalo ngubani owazi ukuchitheka kwabo bobabili?
Lala ngawabahlakaniphileyo. Ukunaka ubuso kusahlulelo kakulunganga.
Othi kokhohlakeleyo: Wena ulungile; abantu bazamqalekisa, izizwe zizamthukuthelela.
Kodwa kulabo abamkhuzayo kuzakuba lentokozo, lesibusiso esihle sizabehlela.
Ophendula ngamazwi aqondileyo uzakwanga indebe.
Lungisa umsebenzi wakho ngaphandle, uzilungiselele wona ensimini, emva kwalokho wakhe indlu yakho.
Ungabi ngumfakazi umelene lomakhelwane wakho kungelasizatho, kumbe ukhohlise ngendebe zakho.
Ungathi: Njengokwenza kwakhe kimi ngizakwenza njalo kuye; ngizaphindisela emuntwini njengokomsebenzi wakhe.
Ngedlula ensimini yevila, lesivinini somuntu oswele ingqondo;
khangela-ke, konke kwakumile ameva, imbabazane yayisibekele ubuso bakho, lomthangala wakho wamatshe udilikile.
Mina-ke ngakukhangela, ngakubeka enhliziyweni yami; ngakubona, ngemukela imfundiso.
Ubuthongo obuncinyane, ukuwozela okuncinyane, ukusonga izandla okuncinyane ukuthi kulalwe,
besebusiza ubuyanga bakho njengesihambi, lenswelo zakho njengomuntu ohlomileyo.
Lalezi yizaga zikaSolomoni abantu bakaHezekhiya inkosi yakoJuda abazikopayo.
Kuludumo lukaNkulunkulu ukufihla udaba, kodwa kuludumo lwamakhosi ukuhlolisisa udaba.
Amazulu ngokuphakama, lomhlaba ngokujula, lenhliziyo yamakhosi kakulakuhlolisiswa.
Susa amanyele esiliveni, besekuphuma isitsha somncibilikisi.
Susa okhohlakeleyo phambi kwenkosi, besekuqiniswa isihlalo sayo sobukhosi ngokulunga.
Ungaziqhenyi phambi kwenkosi, njalo ungemi endaweni yezikhulu;
ngoba kungcono kuthiwe kuwe: Yenyukela ngapha, kulokuthi wehliswe phambi kwesiphathamandla, amehlo akho asibonileyo.
Ungaphangisi ukuphuma ukuyaphikisana, hlezi wenze ulutho ekucineni kwakho, lapho umakhelwane wakho esekuyangisile.
Mela udaba lwakho lomakhelwane wakho, kodwa ungavezi imfihlo yomunye;
hlezi okuzwayo akuyangise, lesigcono sakho singaphambuki.
Ilizwi elikhulunywe ngokufaneleyo linjengama-apula egolide ezitsheni zesiliva ezibaziweyo.
Isongo legolide lesiceciso segolide elihle kungumkhuzi ohlakaniphileyo endlebeni ezwayo.
Isithunywa esithembekileyo kwabasithumileyo sinjengomqando weliqhwa elikhithikileyo ngosuku lokuvuna, ngoba sivuselela umphefumulo wamakhosi aso.
Umuntu oziqhenya ngesipho samanga unjengamayezi lomoya okungelazulu.
Ngokubekezela umbusi angavunyiswa, lolimi oluthambileyo lwephula ithambo.
Utholile yini uluju? Dlana okwenele wena, hlezi uludle kakhulu, uluhlanze.
Unyawo lwakho kalungavami endlini kamakhelwane wakho, hlezi akusuthe akuzonde.
Umuntu ofakaza ubufakazi bamanga ngomakhelwane wakhe uyisagila lenkemba lomtshoko obukhali.
Ukuthemba ongathembekanga ngosuku lokuhlupheka kunjengezinyo elephukileyo, lonyawo olwenyeleyo.
Ohlabelela izingoma enhliziyweni edabukileyo unjengokhupha isembatho ngosuku lwamakhaza, njengeviniga phakathi kwesoda.
Uba okuzondayo elambile, umnike isinkwa adle, njalo uba omile, umnike amanzi anathe;
ngoba uzabekelela amalahle omlilo ekhanda lakhe, leNkosi izakuvuza.
Umoya wenyakatho uletha izulu, lolimi lwemfihlo ubuso obulolaka.
Kungcono ukuhlala engonsini yophahla kulalowesifazana wezinkani lendlini yokuhlanganyela.
Umbiko omuhle ovela elizweni elikhatshana unjengamanzi aqandayo emphefumulweni owomileyo.
Olungileyo ozanyazanyiswayo phambi kokhohlakeleyo ungumthombo odungekileyo lesiphethu esonakeleyo.
Ukudla uluju olunengi kakulunganga; lokuthi badinge udumo lwabo kakusidumo.
Umuntu ongathinti umoya wakhe unjengomuzi ofohlelweyo ongelamthangala.
Njengeliqhwa elikhithikileyo ehlobo lanjengezulu ngesikhathi sokuvuna, ngokunjalo udumo kalusifanelanga isithutha.
Njengenyoni ekuzulazuleni, njengenkonjane ekuphapheni, ngokunjalo isiqalekiso kungelasizatho kasiyikufika.
Isiswepu ngesebhiza, itomu ngelikababhemi, loswazi ngolomhlana wezithutha.
Ungaphenduli isithutha ngokobuthutha baso, hlezi lawe ufanane laso.
Phendula isithutha ngokobuthutha baso, hlezi sibe ngesihlakaniphileyo emehlweni aso.
Othumela amazwi ngesandla sesithutha, uquma inyawo, unatha isihluku.
Imilenze yesiqhuli iyalengalenga; sinjalo isaga emlonyeni wezithutha.
Njengokubophela ilitshe esavutheni, unjalo onika udumo esithutheni.
Njengameva enyuka esandleni sesidakwa sinjalo isaga emlonyeni wezithutha.
Omkhulu owabumba konke uvuza isithutha, avuze abadlulayo.
Njengenja ebuyela emahlanzweni ayongokunjalo isithutha siphinda ubuthutha baso.
Uyabona yini umuntu ohlakaniphileyo emehlweni akhe? Kulethemba elikhulu esithutheni kulaye.
Olivila uthi: Kulesilwane endleleni; isilwane sisezitaladeni.
Isivalo siphenduka ngamabhanti aso, ngokunjalo ivila embhedeni walo.
Ivila lifihla isandla salo emganwini, liyavilapha ukusibuyisela emlonyeni walo.
Ivila lihlakaniphile emehlweni alo okwedlula abayisikhombisa abangaphendula ngenhlakanipho.
Odlulayo engenela ingxabano engeyisiyo eyakhe ungobamba indlebe zenja.
Njengohlanya oluphosa izikhuni ezivuthayo, imitshoko, lokufa,
unjalo umuntu okhohlisa umakhelwane wakhe, abesesithi: Kangisomi yini?
Uba kungelankuni umlilo uyacitsha; njalo uba kungelakunyeya, ukuxabana kuyathula.
Njengamalahle emalahleni avuthayo, lenkuni emlilweni, unjalo umuntu wenkani ngowokubasa ingxabano.
Amazwi onyeyayo anjengezibondlo ezehlela kokungaphakathi kwesisu.
Indebe ezivuthayo lenhliziyo embi kungamanyele esiliva ahuqa ukhamba.
Ozondayo uyazenzisa ngezindebe zakhe, kodwa ufaka inkohliso ngaphakathi kwakhe.
Lapho esenza ilizwi lakhe libe ngelomusa, ungamkholwa, ngoba izinengiso eziyisikhombisa zisenhliziyweni yakhe.
Inzondo isibekelwa ngenkohliso; ububi bakhe buzakwembulwa ebandleni.
Ogebhayo umgodi uzawela kuwo, logiqa ilitshe, lizabuyela kuye.
Ulimi lwamanga luzonda olubachobozayo, lomlomo obutshelezi usebenza incithakalo.
Ungazincomi ngosuku lwakusasa, ngoba kawazi ukuthi usuku luzazalani.
Owemzini kakudumise, njalo hatshi umlomo wakho; owezizwe, njalo hatshi indebe zakho.
Ilitshe linzima, letshebetshebe liyasinda, kodwa ulaka lwesithutha lunzima kulakho kokubili.
Ulaka lulolunya, lentukuthelo iyisikhukhula; kodwa ngubani ongema phambi komona?
Kungcono ukukhuzwa ngokusobala kulothando lwensitha.
Amanxeba omngane athembekile, kodwa ukwanga kwesitha kuyakhohlisa.
Umphefumulo osuthiyo unyathelela phansi uhlanga loluju, kodwa kumphefumulo olambileyo konke okubabayo kumnandi.
Njengenyoni eduha isuka esidlekeni sayo unjalo umuntu oduha esuka endaweni yakhe.
Amafutha lempepha kuthokozisa inhliziyo; kunjalo ubumnandi bomngane womuntu ngenxa yeseluleko somphefumulo.
Ungadeli umngane wakho lomngane kayihlo; njalo ungangeni endlini yomfowenu ngosuku lwencithakalo yakho; kungcono umakhelwane oseduze kulomfowenu okhatshana.
Hlakanipha, ndodana yami, uthokozise inhliziyo yami, ukuze ngibe lempendulo kongisolayo.
Okhaliphileyo uyabona ububi acatshe, kodwa abangelalwazi bayaqhubeka bajeziswe.
Thatha isigqoko soyisibambiso ngenxa yowemzini, umthathele isibambiso ngenxa yowesifazana wezizwe.
Obusisa umngane wakhe ngelizwi elikhulu evuka ekuseni kakhulu, kuzathiwa yisiqalekiso kuye.
Ukuchophelela ngosuku lwezulu eliqhubekayo lowesifazana oxabanayo kuyafanana.
Omfihlayo ufihla umoya, lamagcobo ahlangana lesandla sakhe sokunene.
Insimbi ilolwa ngensimbi; ngokunjalo umuntu ulola ubuso bomngane wakhe.
Olondoloza isihlahla somkhiwa uzakudla isithelo saso; lolinda inkosi yakhe uzadunyiswa.
Njengemanzini ubuso busebusweni, ngokunjalo inhliziyo yomuntu isemuntwini.
Isihogo lencithakalo kakusuthi, ngokunjalo amehlo omuntu kawasuthi.
Imbiza yokucenga ngeyesiliva, lesithando ngesegolide; kunjalo umuntu ngokokudunyiswa kwakhe.
Lanxa ugiga isithutha ngomgigo engigeni phakathi kwengqoloyi, ubuthutha baso kabuyikusuka kuso.
Yazi lokwazi isimo sezimvu zakho, beka inhliziyo yakho kumihlambi yakho,
ngoba inotho kayisiyaphakade; kumbe umqhele ube sesizukulwaneni lesizukulwana yini?
Utshani buyasuswa, lohlaza lubonakale, kubuthwe lemibhida yezintaba.
Amawundlu angawezigqoko zakho, lezimpongo ziyintengo yesiqinti.
Kuzakuba lochago lwezimbuzi olwanele ukudla kwakho lokudla kwendlu yakho lempilo yencekukazi zakho.
Ababi babaleka kungekho umzingeli, kodwa abalungileyo balesibindi njengebhongo lesilwane.
Ngesiphambeko sesizwe ababusi baso banengi; kodwa ngomuntu olokuqedisisa ololwazi ukuqonda kwaso kuyelulwa.
Umuntu ongumyanga ocindezela abayanga ulizulu elikhukhulayo ukuze kungabi lokudla.
Abadela umlayo badumisa ababi, kodwa labo abagcina umlayo balwa labo.
Abantu ababi kabaqedisisi ukulunga, kodwa abadinga iNkosi baqedisisa konke.
Kungcono umyanga ohamba ngobuqotho bakhe kulophambene ngezindlela lanxa enothile.
Ogcina umlayo uyindodana eqedisisayo, kodwa ozihlanganisa lezigangi uyangisa uyise.
Owandisa inotho yakhe ngenzalo langenzuzo uyibuthela olomusa kubayanga.
Ophambula indlebe yakhe ekulaleleni umlayo, lomkhuleko wakhe uzakuba yisinengiso.
Oduhisela abaqotho endleleni embi yena uzawela emgodini wakhe, kodwa abaqotho bazakudla ilifa lokuhle.
Indoda enothileyo ihlakaniphile emehlweni ayo, kodwa umyanga oqedisisayo uzayihlola.
Lapho abalungileyo bethokoza, kulenkazimulo enkulu; kodwa nxa ababi bephakama, umuntu uyadingwa.
Osibekela iziphambeko zakhe kayikuphumelela, kodwa ozivumayo azitshiye, uzahawukelwa.
Ubusisiwe umuntu owesaba njalonjalo, kodwa owenza inhliziyo yakhe ibe lukhuni uzawela ebubini.
Umbusi okhohlakeleyo phezu kwabantu abangabayanga uyisilwane esibhongayo lebhere elizingelayo.
Umbusi oswele ukuqedisisa konke wandisa lencindezelo; ozonda inzuzo embi uzakwelula insuku.
Umuntu ocindezelwe ligazi lomphefumulo uzabalekela emgodini; kabangamsekeli.
Ohamba ngobuqotho uzasindiswa, kodwa ophambene ngendlela ezimbili uzahle awe.
Olima umhlaba wakhe uzasutha ukudla, kodwa olandela abayize uzasutha ubuyanga.
Umuntu wothembeko lonke uzavama ngezibusiso, kodwa ophangisa ukunotha kayikuba msulwa.
Ukuhlonipha ubuso kakulunganga, ngoba umuntu uzakona ngenxa yocezu lwesinkwa.
Ophangisa ukunotha ungumuntu olelihlo elibi, njalo engazi ukuthi ubuyanga buzamehlela.
Okhuza umuntu uzathola umusa emuva okwedlula okhohlisayo ngolimi.
Ophanga uyise kumbe unina, athi: Akusiso isiphambeko; ungumngane womchithi.
Ongasuthisekiyo udunga ingxabano, kodwa othemba eNkosini uzakhuluphaliswa.
Othemba enhliziyweni yakhe uyisithutha, kodwa ohamba ngenhlakanipho uzakhululwa.
Opha umyanga kayikuswela, kodwa ofihla amehlo akhe uzakuba leziqalekiso ezinengi.
Nxa abakhohlakeleyo bephakanyiswa, umuntu uyacatsha, kodwa nxa bebhubha, abalungileyo bayanda.
Umuntu othi ekhuzwa kanengi aqinise intamo, uzahle ephulwe, njalo kungabi lakusiliswa.
Lapho abalungileyo besanda, abantu bayathokoza, kodwa lapho okhohlakeleyo ebusa, abantu bayabubula.
Umuntu othanda inhlakanipho uthokozisa uyise, kodwa ohlanganyela lamawule uchitha inotho.
Inkosi iqinisa ilizwe ngesahlulelo, kodwa umuntu wezipho uyalichitha.
Umuntu olalisa ngolimi umakhelwane wakhe wendlalela izinyawo zakhe imbule.
Esiphambekweni somuntu omubi kulomjibila, kodwa olungileyo uyamemeza ngenjabulo ethokoza.
Olungileyo uyalwazi udaba lwabayanga; okhohlakeleyo kananzeleli ulwazi.
Abantu abadelelayo bayawuthungela umuzi, kodwa abahlakaniphileyo badedisa ulaka.
Umuntu ohlakaniphileyo emangalelana lomuntu oyisithutha, loba elolaka, loba ehleka, kakulakuthula.
Abantu abomele igazi bazonda opheleleyo, kodwa abaqotho badinga umphefumulo wakhe.
Isithutha sikhupha umoya waso wonke, kodwa ohlakaniphileyo uyawuthiba.
Umbusi olalela amazwi amanga, zonke izinceku zakhe zikhohlakele.
Umyanga lomuntu wencindezelo bayahlangana; iNkosi ikhanyisa amehlo abo bobabili.
Inkosi eyahlulela abayanga ngothembeko, isihlalo sayo sobukhosi sizamiswa phakade.
Uswazi lokukhuza kunika inhlakanipho, kodwa umntwana oyekelelwayo uthelela unina inhloni.
Lapho abakhohlakeleyo besanda, isiphambeko siyanda, kodwa abalungileyo bazabona ukuwa kwabo.
Laya indodana yakho, izakuphumuza; yebo, izanika izinjabulo emphefumulweni wakho.
Lapho okungelambono khona, abantu babengabambeki; kodwa ubusisiwe ogcina umlayo.
Inceku kayilaywa ngamazwi; lanxa iqedisisa, kayiyikuphendula.
Uyambona yini umuntu ophangisa ngamazwi akhe? Kulethemba elingcono esithutheni kulaye.
Ototoza inceku yakhe kusukela ebuntwaneni, ekucineni izakuba yindodana kuye.
Umuntu ololaka ubanga ukuxabana, lomuntu ovutha intukuthelo wandisa isiphambeko.
Ukuzigqaja komuntu kuzamehlisa, kodwa olomoya othobekileyo uzabamba udumo.
Owabelana lesela uzonda umphefumulo wakhe; uzwa isiqalekiso, angakhulumi.
Ukwesaba abantu kuletha umjibila, kodwa othemba eNkosini uzabekwa phezulu evikelekile.
Abanengi badinga ubuso bombusi, kodwa isahlulelo salowo lalowo sivela eNkosini.
Umuntu ongalunganga uyisinengiso kwabalungileyo, kodwa oqotho endleleni uyisinengiso kokhohlakeleyo.
Amazwi kaAguri indodana kaJake umMasa. Umuntu wathi kuIthiyeli, kuIthiyeli loUkhali:
Isibili, ngiyisithutha kulomuntu, kangilakuqedisisa komuntu.
Kangifundanga inhlakanipho, kangilwazi ulwazi lwabangcwele.

Ngubani owenyukela emazulwini njalo wehla? Ngubani oqoqe wafumbatha umoya ezandleni zakhe? Ngubani ogoqele amanzi esembathweni? Ngubani omise yonke imikhawulo yomhlaba? Lingubani ibizo lakhe, lebizo lendodana yakhe lingubani, uba usazi?
Lonke ilizwi likaNkulunkulu licwengekile; uyisihlangu kwabaphephela kuye.
Ungengezeleli emazwini akhe, hlezi akukhuze, utholwe ungumqambimanga.
Zimbili izinto engizicele kuwe; ungangigodleli zona ngingakafi.
Susa khatshana lami ize lamazwi amanga; ungangiphi ubuyanga loba inotho; ungiphe ukudla kwesabelo sami.
Hlezi ngisuthe, ngikuphike ngithi: Ngubani iNkosi? Kumbe hlezi ngibe ngumyanga, ngintshontshe, ngithathe ngeze ibizo likaNkulunkulu wami.
Ungahlebi inceku enkosini yayo, hlezi ikuthuke, ube lecala.
Kulesizukulwana esithuka uyise, esingabusisi unina;
isizukulwana esihlambulukileyo emehlweni aso, kodwa esingahlanjululwanga engcekezeni yaso;
isizukulwana omehlo aso aphakeme kangaka, lenkophe zaso ziphakanyisiwe;
isizukulwana omazinyo aso zinkemba, lesimazinyo aso omhlathi zingqamu, zokudla abayanga emhlabeni, labaswelayo ebantwini.
Umkhaza ulamadodakazi amabili athi: Phana, phana; lezizontathu kazisuthi; ezine kazitsho ukuthi: Kwanele.
Ingcwaba, lesizalo esiyinyumba, umhlaba ongasuthi amanzi, lomlilo ongathi: Kwanele.
Ilihlo eliklolodela uyise, lelidelela ukulalela unina, amawabayi esihotsha azalikopola, labantwana bamanqe bazalidla.
Lezizinto ezintathu ziyisimangaliso esikhulu kimi, yebo, ezine engingazaziyo:
Indlela yokhozi emazulwini, indlela yenyoka edwaleni, indlela yomkhumbi enhliziyweni yolwandle, lendlela yejaha entombini.
Injalo indlela yowesifazana oliwule; udla, esule umlomo wakhe, athi: Kangenzanga isiphambeko.
Ngenxa yezinto ezintathu umhlaba uyazamazama, yebo, ngenxa yezine ongezithwale:
Ngenxa yesigqili nxa sibusa, lesithutha nxa sisuthi ukudla,
ngenxa yesaliwakazi nxa sendile, lencekukazi nxa iyindlalifa yenkosikazi yayo.
Lezi ezine zingezincinyane zomhlaba, kanti zihlakaniphile zenziwe zihlakaniphe:
Ubunyonyo buyisizwe esingelamandla, kanti bulungisa ukudla kwabo ehlobo.
Imbila ziyisizwe esingelamandla, kanti zimisa indlu yazo edwaleni.
Intethe kazilankosi, kanti zonke ziphuma zehlukene ngamaviyo.
Umbankwa ubambelela ngezandla ezimbili, njalo usezigodlweni zenkosi.
Lezi ezintathu zinyathela kuhle, yebo, ezine zihamba kuhle:
Isilwane esilamandla phakathi kwenyamazana, esingeyikubuyela emuva ngenxa yobuso loba ngobukabani;
inja ebhince okhalweni, kumbe impongo; lenkosi ileviyo lamabutho.
Uba ube yisithutha ngokuziphakamisa, njalo uba ucebe okubi, beka isandla emlonyeni.
Ngoba ukuphehlwa kochago kuveza iphehla, lokucindezelwa kwempumulo kuveza igazi, lokucindezelwa kwentukuthelo kuveza ingxabano.
Amazwi kaLemuweli inkosi yeMasa, unina amfundisa wona.
Ini, ndodana yami! Ini-ke, ndodana yesizalo sami! Ini-ke, ndodana yezithembiso zami!
Unganiki amandla akho kwabesifazana, kumbe izindlela zakho ekubhubhiseni amakhosi.
Kakusikwamakhosi, Lemuweli, kakusikwamakhosi ukunatha iwayini, kumbe okweziphathamandla ukuloyisa okunathwayo okulamandla.
Hlezi anathe, akhohlwe isimiso, aguqule isahlulelo sawo wonke amadodana enhlupheko.
Phana okunathwayo okulamandla kobhubhayo, lewayini kwabababayo emphefumulweni.
Kanathe, akhohlwe ubuyanga bakhe, angabe esakhumbula usizi lwakhe.
Vulela isimungulu umlomo wakho, udaba lwabo bonke abamiselwe incithakalo.
Vula umlomo wakho, wahlulele ngokulunga, umele ilungelo lomyanga loswelayo.
Ngubani ongathola umfazi okhuthela okulungileyo? Ngoba intengo yakhe iyedlula kakhulu amatshe amahle.
Inhliziyo yomkakhe ithemba kuye, ukuze angasweli impango.
Umenzela okuhle, hatshi okubi, insuku zonke zempilo yakhe.
Udinga uboya bezimvu lefilakisi, asebenze ngenjabulo yezandla zakhe.
Ufanana lemikhumbi yomthengisi; uletha ukudla kwakhe kuvela khatshana.
Uvuka kusesebusuku, anike indlu yakhe ukudla, lesabelo kuzincekukazi zakhe.
Anakane ngensimu ayizuze; ngesithelo sezandla zakhe ahlanyele ivini.
Uyabhinca ukhalo lwakhe ngamandla, aqinise ingalo zakhe.
Uyananzelela ukuthi ukuthengisa kwakhe kuhle; isibane sakhe kasicitshi ebusuku.
Welulela izandla zakhe kuluthi lokuphotha, lezandla zakhe zibambe isigodo esilezintambo.
Welulela umyanga isandla sakhe, elulele izandla zakhe koswelayo.
Kesabi iliqhwa elikhithikileyo ngenxa yabendlu yakhe, ngoba bonke abendlu yakhe bagqokiswe okubomvu.
Uzenzela izembeso; isigqoko sakhe sililembu elicolekileyo leliyibubende.
Umkakhe uyaziwa emasangweni, lapho ehlezi labadala belizwe.
Wenza ilembu elicolekileyo kakhulu, alithengise; anike umthengi ibhanti.
Amandla lodumo kuyisigqoko sakhe; uyahleka mayelana losuku olulandelayo.
Uvula umlomo wakhe ngenhlakanipho; lemfundiso yomusa iselimini lwakhe.
Uqaphela inhambo zomuzi wakhe; kadli isinkwa sobuvila.
Abantwana bakhe bayavuka bathi ubusisiwe, lomkakhe laye uyamdumisa:
Manengi amadodakazi enze ngenkuthalo, kodwa wena wenyukile phezu kwawo wonke.
Ubuhle buyinkohliso, lokubukeka kuyize; owesifazana owesaba iNkosi yena uzadunyiswa.
Mnikeni okuvela esithelweni sezandla zakhe, lemisebenzi yakhe kayimdumise emasangweni.
Amazwi omTshumayeli, indodana kaDavida, inkosi eJerusalema.
Ize leze, kutsho umTshumayeli, ize leze, konke kuyize.
Kuyinzuzoni emuntwini emtshikatshikeni wakhe wonke awutshikatshika ngaphansi kwelanga?
Isizukulwana siyedlula, lesizukulwana size, kodwa umhlaba umi kuze kube nininini.
Lelanga liyaphuma, lelanga litshone, litshetshela endaweni lapho eliphuma khona.
Umoya uya eningizimu, ujikele enyakatho, ujikajike uhambe, lomoya ubuyele ekubhodeni kwawo.
Yonke imifula iya olwandle, kodwa ulwandle kalugcwali; endaweni lapho imifula evela khona, ibuyele iye khona.
Zonke izinto ziyadinisa; kakulamuntu olakho ukukukhuluma. Ilihlo kalisuthi ngokubona, lendlebe kayigcwaliswa yikuzwa.
Okwake kwaba khona yilokho okuzakuba khona, lokwake kwenziwa yilokho okuzakwenziwa; njalo kakulalutho olutsha ngaphansi kwelanga.
Kungaba khona ulutho yini okungathiwa ngalo: Khangela, lokhu kutsha! Kwakuvele kukhona endulo engaphambi kwethu.
Kakukho ukukhunjulwa kwezinto zakuqala; njalo lezinto ezizayo ezizakuba khona kakuyikuba khona ukukhunjulwa kwazo lalabo abazakuba khona emva kwalokho.
Mina mTshumayeli ngangiyinkosi phezu kukaIsrayeli eJerusalema.

Ngasenginikela inhliziyo yami ukudinga lokuhlolisisa ngokuhlakanipha ngakho konke okwenziwayo ngaphansi kwamazulu; lumtshikatshika onzima uNkulunkulu uwunike abantwana babantu ukuthi baphatheke ngawo.
Ngiyibonile yonke imisebenzi eyenziwayo ngaphansi kwelanga; khangela-ke, konke kuyize lokukhathazeka komoya.
Okugobileyo kakulakuqondiswa; lokuswelekayo kakulakubalwa.
Ngakhuluma mina lenhliziyo yami ngisithi: Khangela, mina ngikhulile ngandisa inhlakanipho phezu kwabo bonke ababephambi kwami eJerusalema; njalo inhliziyo yami ibonile kakhulu inhlakanipho lolwazi.
Nganginikela inhliziyo yami ukwazi inhlakanipho, lokwazi ukuhlanya lobuthutha, ngabona ukuthi lalokhu yikukhathazeka komoya.
Ngoba kunhlakanipho enengi kulokukhathazeka okunengi, lowandisa ulwazi wandisa usizi.
Ngathi mina enhliziyweni yami: Woza-ke, ngizakuzama ngentokozo, njalo kholisa okuhle. Khangela-ke, lalokhu kwakuyize.
Ngokuhleka ngathi: Kuyibuhlanya! Langentokozo: Kwenzani?

Ngadinga enhliziyweni yami ukuthokozisa inyama yami ngewayini (kodwa ngakhokhela inhliziyo yami ngenhlakanipho), lokubambelela ebuthutheni, ngize ngibone ukuthi kuyini lokho okulungele abantwana babantu, abangakwenza ngaphansi kwamazulu, ngenani lensuku zempilo zabo.
Ngazenzela imisebenzi emikhulu; ngazakhela izindlu; ngazihlanyelela izivini;
ngazenzela izivande lezivande zezihlahla; ngahlanyela kuzo izihlahla zezithelo zohlobo lonke;
ngazenzela amachibi amanzi okuthelela ngawo ihlathi lokukhulisa izihlahla;
ngathenga izigqili lezigqilikazi, ngaba labazalelwe endlini; njalo ngaba lemfuyo enengi yenkomo lezimvu okwedlula bonke ababekhona ngaphambi kwami eJerusalema;
ngazibuthela futhi isiliva legolide lemfuyo ekhethekileyo yamakhosi leyamazwe; ngazizuzela abahlabeleli labahlabelelikazi, lentokozo zabantwana babantu, amantombazana emihlobo yonke.
Ngakho ngaba mkhulu nganda okwedlula wonke owayekhona ngaphambi kwami eJerusalema, lenhlakanipho yami yema lami.

Lakho konke amehlo ami akufisayo kangiwancitshanga khona, kangigodlanga inhliziyo yami lakuyiphi intokozo; ngoba inhliziyo yami yathokoza ekutshikatshikeni kwami konke; lalokhu kwaba yisabelo sami somtshikatshika wami wonke.

Mina ngasengikhangela yonke imisebenzi izandla zami eziyenzileyo, lomtshikatshika engangitshikatshike ukuwenza; khangela-ke, konke kwakuyize lokukhathazeka komoya, njalo kwakungekho nzuzo ngaphansi kwelanga.
Mina ngasengibuyela ukubona inhlakanipho lobuhlanya lobuthutha. Ngoba angenzani umuntu olandela inkosi? Lokho okuvele sekwenziwe.
Mina ngasengibona ukuthi inhlakanipho ingcono kulobuthutha njengokukhanya kungcono kulomnyama.
Ohlakaniphileyo, amehlo akhe asekhanda lakhe, kodwa isithutha sihamba emnyameni; ngasengisazi lami ukuthi isehlakalo sinye sehlela bonke.

Mina ngasengisithi enhliziyweni yami: Njengoba kusehlela isithutha kuzangehlela lami; pho, kungani-ke mina ngangihlakaniphe okwedlulisileyo? Ngasengikhuluma enhliziyweni yami ukuthi lokhu lakho kuyize.
Ngoba kakukho ukukhunjulwa kohlakaniphileyo okwedlula koyisithutha phakade; ngoba lokhu okukhona khathesi ensukwini ezizayo konke kuzakhohlakala. Ohlakaniphileyo ufa njani? Njengesithutha.
Ngasengizonda impilo, ngoba umsebenzi owenziwa ngaphansi kwelanga wawubuhlungu kimi; ngoba konke kuyize lokukhathazeka komoya.
Yebo, mina ngawuzonda wonke umtshikatshika wami engawutshikatshika ngaphansi kwelanga, ngoba ngizawutshiyela umuntu ozakuba khona ngemva kwami.

Ngubani-ke owaziyo ukuthi uzakuba ngohlakaniphileyo kumbe oyisithutha? Kanti uzabusa phezu kwawo wonke umtshikatshika wami engawutshikatshikayo lengiwenze ngenhlakanipho ngaphansi kwelanga. Lokhu lakho kuyize.
Mina ngasengiphenduka ngadangalisa inhliziyo yami ngomtshikatshika wonke engangiwutshikatshika ngaphansi kwelanga.
Ngoba kulomuntu omtshikatshika wakhe ukunhlakanipho lakulwazi lakubuqotho, kanti uzawunika umuntu ongatshikatshikanga kuwo ube yisabelo sakhe. Lokhu lakho kuyize, lobubi obukhulu.
Ngoba ulani umuntu ngomtshikatshika wakhe wonke langokukhathazeka kwenhliziyo yakhe akutshikatshike ngaphansi kwelanga?
Ngoba insuku zakhe zonke zizinsizi, lomsebenzi wakhe uyikudabuka; lebusuku inhliziyo yakhe kayiphumuli. Lokhu lakho kuyize.
Kakukho okungcono emuntwini kulokuthi adle anathe abonise umphefumulo wakhe okuhle emtshikatshikeni wakhe. Lokhu lakho mina ngabona ukuthi kuvela esandleni sikaNkulunkulu.
Ngoba ngubani ongadla kumbe ngubani ongakholisa kulami?

Ngoba yena uyamnika umuntu olungileyo phambi kobuso bakhe inhlakanipho lolwazi lentokozo; kodwa isoni uyasinika umsebenzi wokubutha lokubuthelela ukunika olungileyo phambi kukaNkulunkulu. Lokhu lakho kuyize lokukhathazeka komoya.
Konke kulesikhathi esimisiweyo, njalo kulesikhathi sayo yonke indaba ngaphansi kwamazulu:
